In this extended Drawalong, Internet megastar DanTDM invites you to power up your pencils and draw a computer gaming pug with pixel-perfect paws!

Dr Maggie reveals the game changers of space - missions and spacecraft, from the Space Shuttle to the Hubble Space Telescope, that have transformed our lives on Earth and beyond. Dr Maggie's star guest is NASA astronaut Kathy Sullivan.
Siblings Nethuni and Abheetha are obsessed with optical illusions and want a den where they can work together to create new tricks to dazzle their friends.

Cam, Tyler and Aaron want to hold a superhero-themed party inspired by the secret superpowers of some of the zoo's most incredible animals. Rica the armadillo comes out of her shell to show off her super-sensitive sniff, and Moby the eagle owl performs awesome aerobatics without making a sound. Meanwhile, Bactrian camels Mo and Navas display some serious suction with their super-slurping, and Cletus the dwarf crocodile arrives at the zoo ready to flex his pecs.
How to save lives in just six lessons. Year 8 dive in to a deep water challenge. For Sean, it's a chance to help him concentrate better while Mary hopes to improve her confidence.
The rhythmic girls are off on a beach clean while Winston competes in France.
When a storm washes Peso onto a mysterious, rocky island, he meets a band of lobster-like insects thought to be extinct.
Cosima takes over Dad's mission to film a unique underwater plant. But his special camera proves harder to operate than she'd thought, and Big Lizard keeps getting distracted.
Nugget joins the Piripenguin Dance Club and grabs the glory with Pancake's signature move - until she's challenged to create her own dance and ends up needing her friend's help.

Eager to prove her babysitting ability for a permit, Gran's on the hunt for a baby stand-in. Walter is suspiciously all too willing to offer up Bertie. Can the gang help Gran wrangle the reluctant baby-sitt-ee?

Mouse wants the other kids to stop being lazy and achieve some goals, in the form of breaking world records. With Mouse's relentless coaching, the family soon gets carried away. Can Mouse get things back to normal before anyone gets hurt?
Bloom searches for Daphne on Domino, only to find Vexius looming in the shadows.

Steve Backshall finds himself in deep water as he goes in search of underwater animals for his `Deadly 60' list. The waters off the coast of Borneo hide a wealth of lethal predators, but just who is worthy of a place on the list? Steve comes face-to-face with a highly venomous scorpion fish and witnesses the formidable spear-mantis impaling its supper with its retractable spear-like arms.
Can Bitzer and Shaun ensure that the regular dance competition is run fairly?
The Bajau Laut people are sea nomads living in the South China Sea. When Ant and Fontaine discover their secret, they're determined to help them.
An angry Swampclops follows the heroes back from their quest for a giant raspberry, so Hoofius must abandon his chances of winning the bake-off.

When the family signs up for the neighbourhood watch, Dog is excited to relive his police dog days. However, when Old Lady McGuire's stinky Camembert cheese is taken, Dog's investigations lead him back home.
The Lemmings find a magic hat that can transform them to match their costumes.
Grizzy's sample of Yummy is mysteriously crushed, but who is the culprit?
Duck's job as an art teacher leads to Frog striking a pose for the class.
Duck is working in a lovely cosy ski lodge, until Frog turns up and ruins everything.
Pablo has started school. It's wild. It's wonderful. It's next level. From baffling rules to chaotic corridors, Pablo tackles it with imagination and help from his book animal friends.
Jim has to survive in a gas station.
Gumball ends up wearing a dress to school one day, which has interesting repercussions when he inadvertently becomes the darling of Elmore High and assumes a new identity.
Shini scales new heights as she cleans the windows of the tallest building in the UK.

Steve Backshall heads to Oman in search of wolves and giant super pods.
Abby sets off on a sea kayaking adventure to spot some incredible wildlife!

The girls' choir enter the nationals, the Joseph cast list drops, and West End star Kaylen prepares for his opening night as Young Simba in `The Lion King'.
The Comets are physically ready to run their first full-out, but emotions run high as Jax realises he has feelings for Olive. Meanwhile, Ruby struggles to keep Melody's plan a secret.

Diving off the coast of Cuba, Steve comes face-to-face with open ocean operators the silky shark. There's more to their metallic looking skin than meets the eye, and Steve reveals how their skin helps to make them streamlined.
Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Potato dedicating a song to his uncle Spud, who went on a spaceship to the moon.
Bing is playing in the garden when he sees his shadow and decides to play shadow tag with Flop. However, Bing is confused when a rain cloud covers the sun and the shadows disappear.
It's Teletubby Circus time. Tinky Winky balances on the tight rope, Dipsy juggles, Laa-Laa flies on the trapeze and Po is a funny clown.
Explore the amazing world around us with baby monkey Tee and his Mum, Mo. Sing along, join in with stories and get ready for some family fun!
Red, Yellow and Blue colour in various doors leading to a range of unexpected places.
After building an enormous tower of blocks, Bluey and Bingo ask Nana to keep the tower up. Nana and Bob try to live in their small unit without knocking the tower over.

Sula, Pando and Bing discover a bird's nest while making a playhouse in the shed. They try to find the bird by being super quiet, and she flies into their playhouse. When Bing goes in to look for her, she flies out again; they can't both be in the playhouse at the same time. So Bing decides to give the shed to her until her chicks have all grown up.
Betty's new ice cream flavour is so light, it makes everybody in town float in the air. How will Mojo and Bo get everyone's feet back on the ground? By floating up there with them!
Duggee hosts a Buddy Bonanza for Mrs Weaver and the Squirrels, with the aim of finding new buddies with common interests to them.
Meet Duggee, a big lovable dog who runs a club for pre-schoolers that inspires children to have fun, be energetic, and - most of all - to do things!
Muffin is playing Grouchy Granny at a garage sale, making Dad push her on an old mobility scooter. When a real Grouchy Granny wants to buy it, Muffin won't budge.
Mum must get Bluey and Bingo out the door in time for their play date with Judo, but the girls won't leave until they finish their game and the sticky rubber gecko falls down from the ceiling.

In order to help protect a sandcastle that he and Tala built, Glitch uses a giant vacuum to suck up the sand from the Academy's beach, exposing the elusive ghost crabs to the hungry seagulls up above.
When Peter accidentally destroys the squirrels' store of nuts with one of Mr Bouncer's misfiring inventions, he sets off to perilous Owl Island to replace them!
Ranger Marsh recounts Shellington's journey to reunite a monitor lizard with his siblings.
An epic adventure begins as Infinaughty turns every single block pink - now who's who?
It's time to join the Wonderblocks for a wonderful talent show!

Love Monster is having his first ever sleepover night with Tiniest Fluffiest Bunny in a tent in his garden, and to make it extra special, he buys a snooze cloud pillow, which has double the bounce and triple the comfort.
Justin has spent days watching his entire film collection and now wants to make his own serious action film.

During Bing's bedtime routine, he inadvertently pees on his blankie, and it's too wet to wash and dry before bed. Fortunately, his Hoppity Voosh toy has a cape just as soft and huggy as a blankie, and it even smells just right too.

Yakka Dee! celebrates children communicating - because talking fills you up with whizz, pop, bang! In this episode, Dee encourages a friend to say 'mouse' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of different beans and explore how they look and taste. We see red beans, green beans, long, thin and lean beans. We see a friend grow some beans, pick them and then eat them for tea.
Tralala brings a periwinkle home and introduces her to an exciting new taste.
Fred and Dana call the Piggy Builders to fix their squeaky door. The Piggies opt to upgrade the entire door, creating the greatest one ever. However, they then forget how to open it.
The Twirlywoos cause confusion at the stables when they keep letting a horse out. Back in the Boat, the Twirlywoos have fun bouncing in and out of the Box.
Maddie meets Tilly at the clinic, where they play in the waiting room and have a check-up with the doctor. Mr Tumble is playing doctor and gives the toys a check-up too.
It is sleepy byes time, so the Teletubbies say goodnight to the Tiddytubbies. But Po isn't tired and goes for a special ride on her scooter.

Nigel and Baby Bear welcome babies Isobel, Idris, Lincoln, Amber, Amelia, Jason, Willow and their grown-ups. Inside everyone's bags are pans which are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding baby appropriate pans inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby.
Elsie plays I Spy during a birthday party with her friends Ethan and Oscar.
Seasonal chef Rob shows the Fact Pack a butternut squash plant.

Rebecca has a new pet plant called Stan. Murphy is very pleased to meet Stan - he loves plants and jungles. This gives him a monster idea for the first make - a terrifically tropical bug made from a reused plastic bottle. The Mini Monsters make bottle fish, and Rebecca's great aunt makes a silly plant for her pet bug. The Recycling Express brings some egg boxes to the attic - just the thing Murphy needs to make a snippy snappy egg box crocodile. The Tiny Helpers add the teeth and eyes.
Kiri, Lou and Sorry are playing tickle monster. They are very surprised when the grumpy Ichtheo wants to join in, but he turns out to be the best monster of all.
A game in the park goes haywire when Bingo stops playing. Now Bluey must win her back.
Duggee and the Squirrels go on a mission to contain an outbreak when Roly inadvertently goes on the run with the world's smelliest cheese, earning their Cheese badges in the process.

Maisie finds out all about some very busy creatures - honeybees. Chantelle meets some of CBBC's Show Me the Honey team, Darcey Mae and Curtis, as they show her the inside of a hive, while Rory and his son Sandy get an unusual view of a busy hive.
It's Elba's birthday and sister Iona is planning a very special tea party for her. Iona and Elba decorate the bedroom ready for the big party, and there are lots of balloons and games to enjoy.
Jen starts a kitchen disco in the café while they bake cakes, but the radio runs out of batteries. Meanwhile, they cook a delicious robot fridge cake for Ruby Robot.

Newfoundland Sylvie is a therapy dog who loves to help people when they're worried. She and her owner Katrina visit all sorts of people every day, young and old. It's Sylvie and Katrina's day off, and they're planning a special lunch.
Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet two tapirs, Inca and Mani, a mother and her son. Next, they head into the dark to encounter another animal that loves fruit, the fruit bat, or flying fox.
Lucy the helicopter paramedic shows us her helmet. She tells us all about how important her helmet is, and how it helps her to do her job and help people.
Gram and Grand visit. Waffle loves Gram, he'll only leave his new doggy doormat on her command. Everyone sings Simon's new song and Waffle uses his doormat to stop Gram leaving.
Bernie embarks on an underground adventure whilst minding Baba and Lala. The old shell proves it still has life in it yet.

Stripes has written a brilliant song, but his guitar string is broken, so he can't play it. Yukee decides to surprise Stripes by enlisting his garden friends to sing the song to him. The trouble is, they can't find the right pitch to sing the song.
Lu refuses a snack that turns out to be yummier than she'd imagined.
The Piggies undertake multiple missions and decide to split up. They soon realise they were all working on Fiona's surprise birthday party.
It's a lovely day for a picnic, but one of the flapjacks is missing. Three may have forgotten what Numberblocks do best.
The Alphablocks find their way out of a maze by learning to read some helpful words.
Justin and his friends visit a zoo, where they meet pandas, lemurs and elephants. Meanwhile, Tumble Cottage ends up full of animals when all the teddies have play dates.
Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po enjoy a game of musical statues. It takes the Teletubbies a few turns to work out that when the music stops they must stand very still.
Baby rhino Maisha is in a bad mood, but her friends help her feel better. Hamza spots some fantastic colobus monkeys in the trees and searches for clues to find the elephants.
Maddie is out and about exploring different ways to travel. She visits an airfield and a workshop to see how a tricycle is constructed.
Motorcycle rider Grace shows off three amazing animal machines: a robotic shark, a bird-like machine and a robotic insect.
The class arrives wearing brightly coloured clothes for a fun-filled activity day. There's a colourful science experiment and a colour safari adventure around the school.
George and Freddie take part in a very special game of tennis. Game, set and match.
The Broccolisaurus needs a haircut. Luckily, their florets are a Pea-Rex's favourite snack.

Captain Barnacles and his intrepid band of explorers roam the oceans in search of adventure and fun. Down in the darkness of the ocean deep, Peso and the Octonauts must help a tiny, injured Dwarf Lanternshark, but they have to find him first.

Peter Rabbit wants to grow up to be just like his late father - he has big paws to fill. But with his father's journal and the help of his best friends Benjamin and Lily, Peter is ready for some fun and delightful new discoveries.
When the squirrels upset the mole by being noisy, Duggee suggests ways that they can all live underground peacefully.
When Millie the Squid devises a set of tough penguin games to test the Piripenguins, Pancake and Nugget must stick together and rely on their friendship to succeed.
Evil Pea thinks the Veggies won't like it when she covers the supermarket in ice, but instead they have the best snow day ever, so she creates a giant snowball to ruin their fun.
Weasy cheats at hide-and-seek by putting a tracking device on the Ducklings.
Preston is in costume as everyone's favourite character, Dewey Dragon. But he isn't ready for how demanding Dewey's fans are - Mojo and Bo need to help him escape the crowd.
The rock monster runs riot in the forest until Zog and the doctors help him.
Penny coaches PC Plum for the You Laugh You Lose contest, but it's trickier than expected.
Waffle finds the club's dressing-up box. Mr Brooklyn-Bell makes use of the costumes for a jungle-themed show, and the box becomes two perfect daybeds for Waffle and George the cat.
Rafi and Jake are making doughnuts. It goes well until Rafi wishes they had more jam.

JoJo and Gran Gran join Jaxon and Ezra in the park for Cynthia's pirate-themed treasure hunt. Who will be the first to find the treasure? Come on, shipmates, and set sail with JoJo and Gran Gran to find out!
Duck wants to be a penguin, so Sarah decides it is time for a trip to the zoo.

Small gives Tiny a lovely sparkly bag which he has caught when fishing in space. It is perfect for Tiny's pan pipes. But when she goes to get her pan pipes out of the bag, she is amazed to find it speaks, in sounds and shapes.
MeMo and BaBa have fun playing tickle chase. BaBa wants to stop playing, and with the help of the Yummies, MeMo learns that there is a time and a place for tickles.

Everyone is enjoying a ride on the Pinky Ponk, but Tombliboo Ooo is more interested in drinking all the Pinky Ponk juice. Inevitably, his tummy is too full so Tombliboo Unn and Tombliboo Eee help him to bed and play music to make him feel better.
Join Harry Styles at bedtime for a heart-warming story celebrating the family home.
Innovative, value-for-money products brought directly to you at home. Shop 'til you drop whilst avoiding the hustle and bustle of the High Street.
Andrew from London, Julie from Sheffield, Lauren from London and Boris from Durham join forces to take on one of the country's finest quiz brains. Hosted by Bradley Walsh.
All that stands between Vicky, Michael, Duncan and Jane and thousands of pounds is the small matter of one of the country's finest quiz brains.

One Chaser is all that stands between voice coach and TV presenter David Grant, Paralympian Jonnie Peacock, TV doctor Pixie McKenna and comedian Andy Hamilton and thousands of pounds for their chosen charities.

Jeremy from Reading has brought in a painting by a Royal Academician, William Russell Flint, of a scene in Rome. The watercolour dates from the turn of the 20th century, and both Nigel and Simon reckon it is an original rather than a print which pushes the price up considerably.

The father and son team of Dan and Peter Snow go head-to-head with experts Charlie Ross and Charles Hanson on the hunt to find the best antique deals. Their journey goes through Hampshire and along the south coast, ending up at an auction in Billingshurst, Sussex.

Two families provide answers to 'everyday questions' that were surveyed by 100 members of the British public before the show to win cash prizes and sometimes mystery prizes for giving a correct answer.
Bradley Walsh presents the big money quiz based on his own idea which features six players who cannot leave the contest until somebody wins.
Ross Kemp presents as a team of four family members, Ros, Steve, Erin and Finn, take on the Bridge of Lies.

A team of five from Merseyside answer top ten list questions as they go in search of a Perfect 10 and a big cash prize.

Bradley Walsh hosts as Charlie Brooks from 'EastEnders', Paralympian Richard Whitehead, comedian Shaparak Khorsandi, and TV's David Dickinson put their knowledge to the test.

Four people who have never met before - Maryanne, Susan, Nadeem and Malcolm - take on the Chaser. Bradley Walsh guides the contestants through the show in the hope they'll go home with thousands of pounds.

In an 'I'm a Celebrity Get Me Out of Here' special, former campmates Iain Lee, Jennie McAlpine, Shappi Khorsandi and Stanley Johnson come together in the hope they can take down a Chaser and win thousands of pounds for charity.
Contestants compete against each other in a fun-filled competition that tests their dart skills and their general knowledge in a bid to win the valuable prizes.

Carrie learns that in the beginning of their relationship Doug lied to her about getting a job at IPS so she would sleep with him.
Doug tries to impress new driver Jared when he learns he was the only one at IPS not invited to Jared's barbecue.
The guys' neighbourhood restaurant names a new sandwich after Deacon, so Doug determines to get some kind of food named after himself.
When Debra accepts a position at Frank's lodge to help plan a member recruitment party, Ray begins to resent how much time she is spending away from home.
When Ray and Debra start having Ally help out around the house, Marie accuses them of turning her into a slave.
Ray catches Debra poking fun at him in front of the children, then realises his mother did the same thing when he was a youngster.

Frasier's antique scout has found for him an antique chess set, and can't wait to play with it. Niles declines, explaining that it will remind him too much of Maris as they used to play every Thursday night.
Niles has been asked to testify, on Court TV, against an old millionaire Harlow Safford. His son believes he is mentally unfit to run his own estate, and wants it handed over to him.
Roz is late for her date, and forces Frasier to speedily drive her there, but unfortunately he gets stopped by a female police officer. He tries to use his celebrity status to get let off.
KACL has a new owner. Frasier learns that he owns 30 stations across the US, and could put Frasier's show into national syndication so he begins a charm offensive with "Big Willy".

If the guys can't get a mammoth 1929 Roadster safely down a decaying 100-year-old lift, they will be 20,000 dollars in the hole. Mike uncovers a surprise when he hears hissing coming from beneath an out-of-control collection.

In North Yorkshire, Naomi and Byron are knee-deep in sludge, while in south Wales, Matt and Michelle lay the groundwork for what will become the heart of their home. And Anouska and Greig are searching for hidden treasure.
In Crosby, handyman Ned and estate agent Josh take on a tired terrace with wonky walls in need of a complete refurbishment. Their mission is to flip it in six months and make a profit.

In Spain, Clare is building a peacock palace. In Normandy, Hayley and Lee have a nervy experience on the roof. And in Romania, Jonas takes his parents for a tour of the village.

After a feisty week in Kent, when some of the B&Bers couldn't even wait until payment day to get their gripes off their chest, it is now actually payment day. And they've saved their most incendiary comments for the main event.
On the final night in Sheffield, property developer Ambrose serves up his favourite, tried-and-tested dishes. After a barrage of questions and some cocky competitive chat, has his night won out?

In France, James and Lauren find out if they have what it takes to start hosting weddings at their 18th-century manor house. In Spain, Alex and Gino's glamping site is at risk of wildfires, and restaurateur Lisa starts a new business venture.
Channel 4's flagship news programme. With sport and weather.

When 10-year-old Yuvraj was diagnosed with blood cancer, his family's world turned upside down. After a life-saving stem cell transplant, complications left him battling graft versus host disease - a cruel twist that changed his appearance forever.

Young married couple Chris and Ellie return to where Chris grew up, in Lancashire's Ribble Valley, to build a home together after Chris is diagnosed with stage four cancer, and buy an old bungalow from his grandparents.
Offering their unmatched satirical insight into current world events, Adam, Josh and Alex are joined by Ellie Taylor and Tim Minchin to help dissect the biggest news stories of the week.
Outrageous antics ensue when Jim, Michelle, Stifler and the gang get back together for their 13-year high school reunion.
Gold-winning Olympic cyclist Victoria Pendleton visits Wood Green to find a dog she can co-parent with her mum. And lovebirds Shai and Orin meet Polo the lurcher.
Mummy Pig suggests the family all make pizzas together, so everyone prepares and chooses the food to make their own individual pizzas.
Peppa and George go behind the scenes to find out how TV is made when Miss Rabbit shows them around the set of Super Potato's TV show.
Tweedy is tidying his den and decides that his ribbon collection would be best kept in a box. When Fluff is left alone with the box, his playful antics leave it, well, very unbox-like.
When Odo hears a rumour that Camp Leader is leaving, he launches a wild scheme to get her to stay. All the birds are swept up in Odo's wild plan, but it's not clear if the rumour is even true.

While Henrietta is getting her seats refurbished, Toby is given a replacement carriage named Hannah. However, she is so headstrong and reckless that Toby gets fed up with her urging him to go faster and faster, and abandons her to visit Henrietta. Meanwhile, Hannah joins up with James - and learns to her cost that going too fast for a little carriage is not at all wise.
Sarah puts on a captivating lunchtime theatre show outside the Wholefish Café. It's so good that Charlie doesn't notice his stove burst into flames.
Peppa finds a small bird on the ground in the garden of her house. She takes him to Dr Hamster, who explains that it is a swift and is probably tired after a long journey.
Pip and Posy get into a disagreement about their artistic visions as they decorate pancake portraits of themselves with different ideas on how to do so.
It's Burn's Night and Mrs Bird teaches Paddington about a rare creature called a Wild Haggis.
When Farmer Yumi and Al's baby goat birthday party goes up in flames, they call on the Fire Rescue Pups to put it out.
Café Carl's kittens cause construction chaos in the Bark Yard! Can the crew create a conclusion to the cat catastrophe?
Peppa and her family collect apples and blackberries in Granny and Grandpa Pig's garden to make a pie.
Mrs Zebra teaches Peppa, George, Zoe, Zaza and Zuzu Zebra how to make a real tea set from clay.
Tim, Tia and Tommy try to convince Mum and Dad to let them have a pet.
Stan finds a tiny ring and is sure it isn't 'The lost treasure of Captain Skinnyfingers' like Grandad claims. He and Gran must solve the mystery!
When a magic trick goes awry, the Adventure Bay Easter Festival is overrun by wild bunnies.
When Milo, Lofty and Lark take care of Horatio's dentist surgery, they love making sure no-one leaves without a dazzling smile.
Peppa and George go to Rebecca Rabbit's house where, instead of stairs and corridors, there are tunnels.
Peppa and her family follow a nature trail in the countryside, discovering footprints left by little birds and ants.

Peppa has a new pen pal, a little donkey from France named Delphine. Peppa receives letters from Delphine Donkey and speaks to her on the telephone. Although Peppa speaks English and Delphine speaks French, they discover that they love lots of the same things, especially jumping up and down in muddy puddles.
The elves and fairies arrive at Planet Bong and meet the Great Leader, the aliens and their pets.
Sophie the Spinosaurus needs to cool down with some friends but feels like she doesn't fit in. It's up to Rex, Ryder and the Dino Rescue Team to find a crafty solution!

Four months ago, Michelle became her own boss when she decided to re-open and run a large bar and restaurant venue on a golf course, and today she hopes to make a sizzling success with her first ever theme night.

It's Erin Burnett's turn to step out front and try to maintain a viable viewer presence for CNN in the weekday news arena. But the former CNBC anchor won't worry about ratings for her hourlong general news program, comparing that burden to "death." Instead, she'll concern herself with translating world events into relevant information for viewers, paying close attention to such topics as the Middle East and women's issues. "I want people to say that our show is smart. I want our show to be authentic", Burnett says in a promo. "I want our show to have courage". Left unsaid, of course, is that she wants her show to have a big audience, too.

In dieser Folge wird die Freundschaft von Stan und Kyle auf die Probe gestellt. Nachdem beide sich im Videospiel "Guitar Hero" versucht haben, spricht ein Musikproduzent Stan an und prophezeit ihm eine steile Karriere. Einziges Problem sei Kyle, der aufgrund seiner schwachen Fähigkeiten das Duo herunterziehe. Also soll sich Kyle einen neuen Partner suchen - was er auch tut. Ob er bereuen wird, sich seiner Freunde entledigt zu haben?

Nachdem sich Cartman eingefroren hat, um die Zeit zum Wii-Launchtermin nicht mitkriegen zu müssen, erwacht er 500 Jahre zu spät aus seinem eisigen Schlaf. Die Zukunft gefällt ihm überhaupt nicht. Nicht zuletzt, weil es in ihr keine Wii gibt, versucht Cartman alles, um wieder in die Gegenwart zurückzufinden!

Tina meint, sie habe die Liebe ihres Lebens gefunden. Dafür verkleidet sie sich als Junge. Sie schleicht sich in ein Casting ein, um ihren Schwarm zu finden. Währenddessen sollen die Belchers Teddys Rattenbaby gesund pflegen.

Louise, Tina und Gene schmieden mit Mr. Fischoeder einen Plan, um den Strandbuggy im Einkaufszentrum zu gewinnen. Teddy versucht in der Zwischenzeit Bob und Linda davon zu überzeugen, ein Huhn aufzunehmen. Er verspricht ihnen regelmäßig frische Eier.

Stan und seine Familie stellen die Charaktere von James Bond in einem Remake dar. Dabei muss Stan als Top-Agent den fiesen Tearjerker, der von Roger gespielt wird und die Erde durch diabolische Filme, die töten können, unsicher macht, stoppen.

Roger beschließt, Fotos von sich zu veröffentlichen. Daraufhin gerät die CIA in Panik und initiiert eine Alien-Taskforce. Zufällig arbeitet Roger bei dieser mit. Stan bekommt dadurch familiäre Probleme und einen neuen Vorgesetzten - nämlich Roger.

Da der Schulausschuss damit droht, ihnen die Mittel zu entziehen, beschließen Janine und Gregory, Ava bei ihrer Präsentation zu helfen. Ihr Plan läuft jedoch schief, als Ava unerwartet aus dem Konzept gebracht wird.
Trotz der Warnungen seiner Eltern verleiht Chris sein Fahrrad an einen Jungen. Dieser haut sofort damit ab und Chris steht vor der Frage wie er das seinen Eltern erklären soll.

Als ein Nachbar Eve Konkurrenz im Schneeräumen macht, verschafft Mike ihm eine Stelle im Laden, als er sieht, wie viele Jobs der Mann annehmen muss, um seine Familie zu ernähren. Mandy und Kyle schaffen es, offen über ihre Gefühle zu sprechen.

Vanessa fühlt sich schuldig, nachdem Mandy ihretwegen die Beziehung mit Kyle beendet hat. Sie selbst hat ihrer Tochter immerhin ins Gewissen geredet. Sie versucht, die Situation zu bereinigen, doch dadurch wird alles nur noch schlimmer.
Malcolm hilft einem arbeitslosen Stelzenläufer wieder Arbeit zu finden. Hal vertelefoniert 800 Dollar bei einer Sex-Hotline und Lois ist dementsprechend schlecht gelaunt.
Hal wird zum Präsidenten des Nachbarschaftsvereins gewählt. Malcolm verspricht sich davon so einige Vorteile, doch schon nach kurzer Zeit hat Hal alle Nachbarn gegen sich aufgehetzt.

Bastian lebt mittlerweile in einem eleganten Hotel und gilt als der Babyretter von Solingen. Allerdings gerät er unter Druck, als er in einer Talkshow eine falsche Behauptung aufstellt. Da die Presse Beweise fordert, lässt er sich etwas einfallen.

Stan kann es nicht mehr ertragen, dass er keine Zeit für sich hat, da er von der Familie voll in Beschlag genommen wird. Ein Kollege erzählt ihm, dass es Wunderpillen gibt, nach deren Einnahme man das Gefühl hat, acht Stunden geschlafen zu haben. Diese Pillen nimmt Stan, um nachts seine Freiheit und Freizeit genießen und tagsüber normal arbeiten gehen zu können. Francine kommt ihm allerdings auf die Schliche und greift ebenfalls zu den Pillen.

Stan vergisst, Roger Grenadine vom Supermarkt mitzubringen, sodass dieser nicht sein Lieblingsgetränk trinken kann. Daraufhin beschließt Roger, Stan das Leben zur Hölle zu machen. Als Erstes lässt er sein Auto abschleppen. Als er sich dann auch noch zum Vorsitzenden der Eigentümerversammlung wählen lässt, wird Stan wütend und holt mit seiner Tochter zum Gegenschlag aus.

Dass Stan nicht Fahrrad fahren kann, ist erst herausgekommen, als Steve die beiden für ein Rennen angemeldet hat. Das hat in Stan den Wunsch geweckt, mit seinem verschollenen Vater zu reden. Der ist aber im Gefängnis, also holt Stan ihn heraus.

Mum erhält zum Muttertag Geschenke von allen Robotern, die in der Fabrik entstanden sind. Doch eigentlich mag sie den Tag nicht. In diesem Jahr ist sie besonders schlecht gelaunt, denn sie wird an eine einstige Liebe erinnert.

Die Freunde lassen sich von Professor Farnsworths "Was wäre, wenn"-Maschine zu Exkursen in ihre Leben verführen. Bender findet heraus, was wäre, wenn er 150 Meter groß wäre. Wäre Fry nicht eingefroren worden, hätte dies gravierende Folgen gehabt.

Tina, Louise und Gene sind dem Kinder-Unternehmer-Club, der von der Schule angeboten wird, beigetreten. Dort können sie zum ersten Mal Unternehmensluft schnuppern. Bob und Linda werden derweil von jemandem, der die Zeche prellt, übers Ohr gehauen.

Zu Halloween wollen die Kinder wieder mit ihren Streichen die Nachbarschaft in Angst und Schrecken versetzen. Doch dann verschwindet ihre Tasche mit allen Süßigkeiten plötzlich. Tina, Louise und Gene machen sich auf die Suche.

Die Mädchen der vierten Klasse haben eine geheime Liste gemacht, die alle Jungs nach ihrem Aussehen von süß bis hässlich einstuft. Als die Jungs die Liste stehlen, sind sie nicht auf die Resultate vorbereitet. Vor allem Kyle leidet sehr darunter.

Nach einer Mandeloperation wird bei Cartman festgestellt, dass er mit dem HI-Virus infiziert ist. Kyle kann sich nicht zurückhalten und macht sich darüber lustig. Aus Rache steckt Cartman ihn im Schlaf auch mit dem Virus an. Gemeinsam machen sich die beiden daraufhin auf die Suche nach einem Heilmittel. Hilfe versprechen sie sich von Basketballstar 🏀 [NBA] Magic Johnson, der ebenfalls seit Jahren infiziert ist, aber bei dem es nicht ausbricht.
Nach einem skurrilen Unfall sitzen Stan und Roger in der denkbar schlimmsten Weise zusammen fest.
Der Traum der Familie, den Mount Everest zu erklimmen, wird zum Albtraum.
Cam ist sehr konzentriert - und rabiat - als ein großes Football-Spiel ansteht. Claire will sich mit ihrer Arbeit beweisen. Phil versucht, seinen Kindern Optimismus beizubringen.
Jay und Manny wollen einen Weihnachtsbaum fällen. Glorias Mutter kommt zu Besuch und treibt Gloria in den Wahnsinn. Mitch geht einkaufen, um ein Geschenk für Lily zu finden.

Malcolm, Reese und Dewey melden ihre Mutter bei einem Schönheitswettbewerb an. Auch Hal unterstützt die Idee und stellt fortan alles vor Lois' Erfolg. Reese findet unterdessen heraus, dass er dem absoluten Schönheitsideal entspricht.
Malcolm und Reese fahren gemeinsam zum berühmten Burning-Man-Festival. Reese verliebt sich Hals über Kopf und will gar nicht mehr, dass das Festival jemals wieder endet.
Sam will das Geheimnis um Albertas Tod ergründen. Hetty entwickelt eine ungewöhnliche Beziehung.

Bastian findet immer mehr Gefallen an seiner Rolle als Babysitter und Mafalda wächst ihm ans Herz. Sein Selbstbewusstsein wächst, bis er es zu weit treibt. Als er versucht, sich in die Erziehung einzumischen, stoppt Svenja ihn.

Leela, Bender und Fry melden sich als Reservisten für die Armee und kurz darauf kommt es zum Krieg. Fry soll Henry Kissinger zu Friedensverhandlungen auf dem Planeten Spheron Eins begleiten, der von ballförmigen Aliens bewohnt wird.

Nachdem die gesamte Crew seinetwegen gefeuert wurde, tauschen Fry und Leela ihre Karrierechips. Leela liefert daraufhin Pizzas aus und Fry arbeitet als Tiefkühl-Berater. Dabei trifft er seine Exfreundin Michelle und landet mit ihr in Los Angeles.

Roger entdeckt, dass jemand mit einer Partnerkarte seine Kreditkarte ausgereizt hat und beschließt, den Gauner zu finden. Als er diesen tatsächlich findet, macht er ihm das Leben schwer und Familie Smith gerät in ein kompliziertes Verwirrspiel.

Der CIA wird das Folter-Budget gestrichen. Jetzt überlegt man im Hauptquartier, wie man genug Geld organisieren könnte, um die zukünftigen Folterungen selbst zu finanzieren. Roger schlägt Stan vor, einen Spendenmarathon zu organisieren, um die CIA-Folterungen zu finanzieren. Der stimmt dem Angebot zu, gibt die Idee jedoch als seine eigene aus.
Kyle hilft seinem kleinen Bruder Ike, sich bei Aura Battles nicht peinlich zu verhalten.

Rick ist erschöpft, weil immer mehr lustige, aber auch sehr merkwürdige Charaktere auftauchen. Morty drängt ihn dazu, eine Therapie zu machen und herauszufinden, warum es so viele Schurken ausgerechnet auf ihn abgesehen haben.
Wenn Rick einem nahelegt, etwas nicht zu tun, sollte man wirklich auf ihn hören. Morty weiß nicht, worauf er sich einlässt, als er ein Geschenk von einem Fremden erhält.
Die Smiths gehen bei ihrem Lieblingschinarestaurant essen und lesen ihren Glückskeksspruch laut vor.
Beavis und Butt-Head warten auf den TV-Empfang und dösen auf der Couch ein und draußen ist Chaos.
Die beiden zerstören ihr Haus mit Baseballschlägern, als sie versuchen, eine Fliege zu töten.

Der Bruder von Daffyd Thomas outet sich als schwul, was Daffyd gar nicht gefällt. Denn er ist doch `der einzige Schwule im Dorf'. Deshalb rät er ihm, bisexuell zu werden. Anne geht in den Park, um Enten zu füttern - auf ihre Art. Vicky macht in einem Bus Ärger und sich selbst ziemlich lächerlich.

Für 10000 Pfund behauptet Vicky auf dem Polizeirevier, dass sie einen Raubüberfall bezeugen kann. Der Traumkredit eines jungen Paares wird abgelehnt. Bubbles De Vere will durch Körpereinsatz einer Zahlung entkommen. Ein Feinschmecker will Junk-Food.

Vanessa soll an Boyds Schule zu Halloween für eine tolle Party sorgen. Sie wird richtig kreativ und geht in der Gestaltung einer Spuklandschaft richtig auf. Doch als Boyd das Gelände testet, wird schnell klar, dass Vanessa zu weit gegangen ist.

Ray reluctantly accompanies Debra to parenting classes, then discovers that he can put the skills he learns to good use with his own parents.
Ray reluctantly agrees to take Robert out on the anniversary of his divorce, but is disturbed by the 'brotherly bonding thing' that develops.
Ray wants to teach Ally not to be a quitter, so he resumes the piano lessons he dropped 25-years earlier. Then he wonders why he ever gave up in the first place.
Ray's guilt catches up with him when he tricks Debra, with Kevin's help, into letting him play a round of golf.
Caroline and Charlie lie to new acquaintances.
Joanna needs a bra, Charlie buys her a skateboard.

A substitute teacher turns up at school, but the teacher is actually Vesta, one of her aunts, who takes Sabrina to her luxurious home.
One of Sabrina's classmates is trying to become a magician and Sabrina helps out by becoming their assistant, but when she uses her magic, things go wrong.
Sabrina isn't impressed when Libby makes fun of a 'geek' at school - so deciding to turn the tables, Sabrina turns Libby into a geek as well.
Ricky Gervais, Stephen Merchant and Karl Pilkington discuss the time when Karl failed to report an armed robbery.

In this show, topics include 'Room 102', based on George Orwell's 'Room 101' from 'Nineteen Eighty-Four'; an idea for stopping overweight people from eating late-night snacks, and what Karl would take to a desert island.

While taking an engagement picture for himself and Monica, Chandler can't stop pulling a strange face, Rachel enlists Joey to take Tag out for a night on the town, and Phoebe and Ross date a couple in the middle of a divorce.

Wedding fever continues when Monica can't decide whether to appoint Rachel or Phoebe as her maid of honour. To help Monica decide, Joey and Ross test them on how they would react in certain wedding situations.

Ross is elated that the university library contains his doctoral dissertation, but he is shocked to discover that it is located in a remote corner frequently used by students having sex. Elsewhere, the tables are turned on Joey when Erin is the one to just want sex and not a relationship.

Joey may have ruined Rachel's chances with Tag when he opens his mouth during Thanksgiving dinner, and Phoebe reveals that she has been secretly keeping a cute dog in her room for a few days while its owner is away.
Stand-up legend Lee Evans is in cracking form for this sold out gig at the O2 arena where he describes his late-night supermarket trips and explains how he treats his daughter's boyfriends!
At Frank and Marie's anniversary party, Ray discovers that his parents split up for a year and only got back together after Ray fell off his bike and broke his arm. He can't help feeling guilty.

Monica is so perturbed by Chandler's instant attraction to her gorgeous visiting cousin that she persuades Ross to let her stay at his flat. Despite being her blood relative, Ross cannot restrain himself from attempting to kiss her. She escapes to Phoebe's flat, but her beauty flabbergasts even Phoebe.

Rachel bumps into a girl she knew in college, and Monica tells everyone they made out once when they were drunk. While making their seating plans for the wedding, Chandler is sad that only 10 percent of the guests are his.
With only four weeks until their wedding, Monica and Chandler try to write their vows. Chandler enlists the boys' help, while Monica does the same with the girls.

Monica convinces a reluctant Chandler to travel to Las Vegas to invite his estranged cross-dressing father to their wedding. Meanwhile, Rachel is furious that she is the only friend who Monica has not allowed to drive the Porsche that her father gave her.
Monica and Chandler prepare for their wedding. Meanwhile, Joey is starring in a movie with a prestigious actor with a spitting problem.
Joey encounters problems trying to get off the movie set to officiate the wedding when the star turns up drunk.

Monica and Chandler's wedding reception is almost upstaged by the news that someone might be pregnant. Meanwhile, Ross tries to impress a pretty single woman, Chandler has troubles on the dance floor, and Joey hopes to impress Chandler's mum's date, an important Broadway producer, with his acting ability.
The girls speculate as to who's the father of Rachel's baby, the guys scramble after Chandler loses the film from his wedding, and Monica wants to open the wedding gifts.
Everybody seems to know who the father of Rachel's baby is except the man himself. Meanwhile, Phoebe and Joey lie about a gas leak to get into Monica and Chandler's apartment.
Ross gets upset when Rachel goes out on a date with a handsome actor, Phoebe tries to prevent a chef from being sacked, and Chandler kills a co-worker's promotion.
At Monica's Halloween party, Phoebe meets the friendly fiancé of her flighty twin Ursula, but becomes alarmed when she learns that her sister has misrepresented herself to her trusting future in-law.

Ross learns that a pregnant Rachel wants to move out and find a place of her own, so he suggests a vacancy in his building. Then he learns that the elderly occupant is not quite dead yet. Meanwhile, Phoebe is ecstatic when Eric dumps her twin sister Ursula and chooses her instead, and Monica comes unhinged when she suspects that her new maid is stealing her jeans, among other things.

Feeling guilty for denying Chandler a bachelor party, Monica hires a stripper to perform for him, without learning that she's a prostitute. Elsewhere, Rachel's father learns about her pregnancy and plans to give Ross a piece of his mind.

An old high-school friend of Monica's is invited to the Thanksgiving dinner with the gang, but Monica is unaware that he isn't exactly fond of Rachel. Meanwhile, Chandler and Phoebe pretend to be mesmerised by American football in order to avoid helping Monica in the kitchen, and Joey vows to devour the entire turkey single-handedly.
Chandler is aghast when Monica buys painfully expensive boots, and Phoebe tries to capitalise on her discovery that Ross's son attends school with the son of rock star Sting.

To prepare Joey for his big date the following night, Rachel eagerly agrees to go out with him for a rare night on the town. However, when each is pleasantly surprised with their newfound compatibility, they begin to regard each other in a way that no one could have predicted.

Bernie and Leepu are looking for another rust bucket to turn into a supercar, but everything is in good condition. Luckily, a friend helps out.

A 30-truck charity hay convoy delivers supplies to drought-stricken King Island, rookie Harrison Hooper tackles his toughest challenge yet, and Irish trucker Liam O'Connor braves the outback's harshest conditions.

Bluey geht zum ersten Mal in ihrem Leben ins Kino. Doch sie hat Angst, denn der Film könnte zu gruselig für sie sein. Bluey muss ihren ganzen Mut beweisen und schließlich auch noch Papa helfen, als Bingo im Theater Amok läuft.
Der Grüne Kobold benutzt eine Fernbedienung, um die Tauben der Stadt zu kontrollieren.
Amber fühlt sich ausgeschlossen. Layla freundet sich mit Amber an.
Bei einer Geburtstagsfeier gibt es ein Missverständnis. Fabius hilft anderen Köchen.
Phil fühlt sich nicht geschätzt, während Claire damit beschäftigt ist, das Geschäft zu führen.
Aufgrund von Stromausfällen während eines Gewitters geht die Familie zu Jay und Gloria.
Das letzte Thanksgiving war eine Katastrophe, denn Kitty hat während des Festes angefangen, auf Larry einzuprügeln. Deshalb wollen Dharma und Greg dieses Jahr unbedingt ohne Eltern feiern.
Gregs Kanzlei kämpft noch immer mit Anlaufschwierigkeiten. Deshalb lässt er einen Werbespot drehen, mit Dharma in der Hauptrolle.
Greg benötigt dringend eine neue Sekretärin und Dharma greift ihrem Mann bei der Suche unter die Arme. Schon bald ist die erste Kandidatin gefunden: die wunderschöne Jurastudentin Kim.
Barbara und Isa planen verschiedene Silvesterpartys. Die Party mit der längeren Gästeliste soll schlussendlich stattfinden. Die beiden kämpfen um jeden Gast und erleben eine Überraschung.

Jess findet heraus, dass Schmidt und Cece eine Affäre haben und ist zutiefst verletzt. Sie sagt der Geheimniskrämerei in der Wohngemeinschaft den Kampf an. Cece und Jess nehmen an einem Wohltätigkeitslauf teil. Nick hat eine Studentin aufgegabelt.

Jess führt Russell in den Alltag der Wohngemeinschaft ein und stellt dabei erste Fehler an ihrer scheinbar makellosen Beziehung fest. Schmidt und Nick versuchen sich als Erfinder und Winston stehen berufliche Veränderungen bevor.

Bentley will in die Vergangenheit reisen, um den Tag von Taffys Ankunft ungeschehen zu machen. Während Taffy um seinen Kaviar trauert, plagt Bentley der Liebeskummer wegen Ferrari. Alex bemerkt ungewöhnliche Kratzspuren an der edlen Tapete.
Dieses Mal soll Beni einen ganzen Tag alleine in der Wildnis verbringen. Ein Training hilft ihm.
Marinette beschließt, sich mit dem Vater ihres Schwarms auszusprechen. Ihr Mut beflügelt Kagami.
Als Lila Neuwahlen ausruft, um Marinette zu ersetzen, geht der Wahlkampf schief.
Cricket und Tilly lernen ihren Großvater kennen. Nancy versucht, einen Job für ihn zu finden.
Inspektor McFlare glaubt, dass der Diamantendieb den Diamanten der Königin stehlen will.

Inspektor Kahiko aktiviert versehentlich zwei diebische Experimente, die sich sofort ans Werk machen: Ihre Diebstahlserie spannt sich innerhalb kürzester Zeit über die gesamte Insel. Lilo und Stitch finden anfangs noch, dass nichts weiter dabei ist.

Candace wünscht sich einen Mom-Magneten von Phineas und Ferb, damit ihre Mutter die Jungs endlich erwischt. Baljeet glaubt, dass die Ferien seiner Intelligenz schaden. Phineas und Ferb bauen ihm einen besonderen Helm.
Bluey und Chloe können jede Rolle spielen, die sie nur wollen, als sie sich ins Abenteuer stürzen.
Während sie Nachahmer spielen, findet Bluey einen verletzten Wellensittich.

Indy und Rusty spielen Mutter-Vater-Kind und können sich nicht darauf einigen, wer von ihnen zur Arbeit geht, also hören sie auf, miteinander zu spielen. Indy hat Schwierigkeiten, einen Babysitter zu finden, und Bluey macht Rusty zu ihrem Baby.

Ladybug hat die Miracle Box verloren. Monarch war noch nie so nah am Sieg. Diese neue Prüfung wird sie für immer prägen. Monarch hat die letzten Figuren seines bösartigen Plans auf seinem Schachbrett des Bösen platziert.

Mike hat einen Traum: Er möchte professioneller Schrecker werden, doch muss er dafür die hohe Kunst des Erschreckens lernen. Dafür macht sich Mike auf den Weg zur Monster-Universität - eine renommierte Einrichtung für jede Art von Monster. Das Aushängeschild der Uni sind die Schreckwissenschaften, in der sich Mike einschreibt. Er ist glücklich, endlich ein Student zu sein und lernt im Studentenwohnheim andere Monster kennen, wie Jeff, Needleman und Smitty, sowie seinen neuen Mitbewohner Sulley.
Movie, Animated, Children, Comedy, Fantasy, Adventure

Die Monster AG ist eine große und erfolgreiche Schrei-Verarbeitungsfabrik der Monsterwelt. Nacht für Nacht begeben sich die angestellten Monster in die Zimmer schlafender Kinder und erschrecken sie, um ihre Angstschreie einzusammeln. Die Monster Sulley und Mike Wazowski sind ein überaus erfolgreiches Team. Doch eines Tages geschieht das, was alle Monster fürchten: Ein Menschenkind gelangt in die Monsterwelt und sorgt dort für ein riesiges Durcheinander.
Movie, Animated, Children, Comedy, Fantasy, Adventure

Will Turner und Elizabeth Swann haben sich notgedrungen mit Captain Barbossa verbündet, um Jack Sparrow aus dem Reich der Toten zurückzuholen. Währenddessen treibt Davy Jones mit seinem Geisterschiff, dem "Fliegenden Holländer", weiterhin sein Unwesen auf den Weltmeeren. Gemeinsam mit dem Fiesling Lord Beckett will er die Kontrolle über die Meere an sich reißen. Will, Elizabeth, Jack und Barbossa müssen die beiden unschädlich machen, denn die Zukunft aller Piraten steht auf dem Spiel.

Neueste Produkte werden im Fernsehen für ein bequemes Einkaufserlebnis präsentiert. Von praktischen Haushaltshelfern und weichen Badetüchern bis hin zu vielseitigen Sportgeräten bietet das abwechslungsreiche Sortiment zahlreiche Angebote.
Diese Sendung wirbt für verschiedene Produkte, die man sich bequem nach Hause schicken lassen kann.

Klaus Borrmann und sein Team haben es diesmal mit einem Fera, Baujahr 1979, zu tun. Er ist eine Replik eines Jaguar XK120 und beherbergt einen 4-Liter-Chevy-Motor. Das Fahrzeug hat jedoch gleich die Tücke, dass es überhaupt nicht anspringen will.

Auf einem Campingplatz in Caputh müsste der Brandschutz neu ausgerichtet werden. Doch es fehlt auch Personal, auf das man sich verlassen kann. Da der Küchenchef gekündigt hat, muss dringend eine Lösung her, um die Gastronomie am Leben zu erhalten.

Das neue Wahrzeichen des Campingplatzes soll saniert werden, doch dann fällt eine Maschine im Betonwerk aus, sodass sich die Lieferung der Baustoffe verschiebt. Derweil reist Frank mit zwei Bussen an und William hat alle Hände voll zu tun.

Dave Turin und sein Team verlieren durch den sinkenden Wasserdruck haufenweise Geld. Deshalb muss schnell eine Lösung her, jedoch scheint das Problem nicht die Pumpe zu sein, sondern eine Lehmschicht im Boden.

David Turin und sein Team bekommen Hilfe von einer Konzentrat-Zentrifuge. Mit der neuen Maschine wollen sie ihre Gewinne um bis zu 40 Prozent steigern, jedoch gibt der Boden trotz vielversprechender Testergebnisse nur wenige Erdmetalle her.

Kapitän Bill Wichrowski hat bereits seine Fangquote erreicht. Es gelang der Crew, in nur zwei Wochen 45 Tonnen Krabben zu fangen. Bei der Ankunft in Dutch Harbour kümmert sich Bill um ein Problem: Einer seiner Seemänner wird per Haftbefehl gesucht.

Die Männer müssen auf See zusammenhalten. Deshalb fasst sich dieses Mal Bill Wichrowski ein Herz und hilft dem jungen Skipper Josh Harris aus der Patsche. Der hat nämlich seine Ausrüstung an Land vergessen und ist nun aufgeschmissen.

Michael Manousakis möchte seinem alten Jugendfreund einen besonderen Wunsch erfüllen. In der Zwischenzeit gibt der Leuchtreklamehersteller bei den Steel Buddys ein Einzelstück in Auftrag, das es in Deutschland so noch nie gegeben hat.

Michael Manousakis und sein Team sind mit einem ausgemusterten Lotsenboot in der Nordsee unterwegs. Dort wollen sie 160 Tonnen Kupfer vom Meeresgrund heben, jedoch ist ihr Fahrzeug über 40 Jahre alt und eigentlich nur noch für Kurzstrecken geeignet.

Eine unklare Fahrzeughistorie und widersprüchliche Aussagen machen Pam in Nürnberg misstrauisch. Ihr Kollege Norman entdeckt an dem Ford Explorer zudem technische Mängel. Unter diesen Voraussetzungen kommt ein Geschäft kaum infrage.

In Karlsruhe wollen zwei Damen eine Menge Goldschmuck verkaufen, unterstützt von Erfahrung aus dem Pfandleihhaus. In Offenburg wird ein ramponierter Krankenwagen bewertet, während in Nürnberg eine echte Breitling das gewünschte Darlehen sichert.
Die Sondersendung bietet ungefilterte Einblicke in den Alltag bei Morlock Motors.

Beim Morlock-Motors-Team kehrt seit einiger Zeit schon keine Ruhe ein. Die Geschäfte laufen auf Hochtouren und vor allem medizinische Gerät sind derzeit gefragt. Die Sendung liefert exklusive Einblicke in den Alltag der Stahlexperten.

Die Sendung informiert über alle wichtigen Neuigkeiten aus der Welt. Die Zuschauer bekommen so einen Überblick über den aktuellen Stand verschiedenster Themen wie Gesellschaft, Kultur, Politik, Sport, Wirtschaft und Zeitgeschehen.

Michael Manousakis ist bereit für das Abenteuer seines Lebens. Der "Morlock Motors"-Chef wagt seinen ersten Transatlantikflug in seiner selbst restaurierten, 41 Jahre alten Antonov An-2 - dem größten einmotorigen Doppeldecker der Welt.

Phaedra, Alyssa und Tawny kommen an ihre körperlichen Grenzen. Seit fünf Tagen haben die Survival-Kandidaten nichts gegessen und kaum geschlafen. Die brütende Hitze Afrikas setzt ihnen extrem zu. Trotzdem begeben sie sich erneut auf die Jagd.

Kim geht es überhaupt nicht gut: Sie klagt über starke Kopfschmerzen und Übelkeit. Möglicherweise hat sie sich mit Krankheitserregern infiziert. Ihr Partner Darrin versucht alles, um etwas Nahrung aufzutreiben, damit Kim wieder zu Kräften kommt.

Mining empires expand and clash in an epic battle to dominate Nome. Mr Gold has a plan to yield 3000 ounces. The Kellys impress a new investor. Vernon builds a kingdom on Claim 56. Zeke has a deal to work Tomcod. Emily makes a surprise announcement.

Empires expand and clash in an epic battle to dominate mining in Nome, AK. Mr. Gold plans to yield 3000 ounces. The Kellys impress a new investor. Vernon builds a kingdom on Claim 56. Zeke has a deal to work Tomcod. Emily has a surprise announcement.
A gold drought puts huge pressure on Jacqui and Andrew's partnership. Meanwhile, the Poseidon Crew face extreme weather when they go on the hunt for gold on a remote mountain pass.
The Perrins brothers are heading into the deep wilderness of Sheep Lake where they have just two weeks to construct a single-storey cabin with archaic tools.

Bryce Ward, the mayor of North Pole, Alaska, joins forces with his father, Jeff, to build a family cabin with the help of their lifelong camping buddies. As the team finishes building the cabin, a forest fire threatens to destroy it.

King Crab's return ignites a derby-style race. After losing the Saga, Jake joins Sig as co-captain. A serious hip injury tests Sophia. Fire on the Wizard traps Keith's deckhand below deck. Bill faces his hardest test yet.
Josh Gates delves into Wild West lore to find Butch Cassidy's missing money. He traces the iconic outlaw's footsteps through Colorado, Utah and Nevada.

Josh investigates how a group of Norse tribesman gained power in medieval Europe. His search for answers begins in their one-time home base of Denmark and continues on to the first place they expanded off the continent, Iceland.

An extended family of homesteaders are on the brink of disintegration in Texas, crowded with their animals on a sliver of their land. To overcome the rift between the homesteaders and the homestead itself, the Raneys must execute an epic overhaul.
The Tunnel Rats risk their lives to get a massive digger under the ground, hoping it will pay off. Meanwhile, the Blacklighters are amazed to unearth the largest piece of opal they have ever found.
The Bushmen's new worker faces a dangerous first day on the job. The Tarantos' overworked excavator grinds to a halt, and the Cheals are hit with more breakdowns in their search for Opal.

Paul Mackie and his team must help a crew that is searching for gold for the first time. For three years the team has been struggling to find gold, and if something doesn't change soon their business will go under.
Paul Mackie and his team travel to Pilbara in Australia's unforgiving west to help an indigenous family mine gold to save them from financial ruin.

A deadly tragedy on a motorway in Oklahoma sends one of the state's busiest bridges collapsing into the Arkansas River below; expert engineers investigate how a tugboat striking a reinforced concrete pier could cause such a catastrophic disaster.

Revealing recent natural disasters as they happened in real-time through footage captured by eyewitnesses who found themselves in the wrong place at the right time and boldly held up their camera phones to capture the eye of the storm.
Expedition X explores an abandoned and haunted outpost in the Amazon rainforest; meeting with tribes deep in the jungle, they hear strange things at night that cause panic.
Pro surfer Anastasia Ashley and YouTuber Cory Williams are stranded in the jungles of Belize. Do they have what it takes to survive without food, water or clothes?

The crew travels to Pennsylvania to save what it can from Esther Ludwig's mansion before it gets demolished, hoping to reclaim some of the mansion's original items, such as chandeliers, built-ins and mantles; Mike buys an old vintage wheelchair.
The Salvage Dawgs travel to Hot Springs, Virginia, to salvage a late Victorian-style home's mantles, cabinets, sinks and round window.

Xaver, Frank und Ronny sind in einem Patentamt angestellt, doch ihr Chef lässt ihnen keinen Spaß an ihrer Arbeit. Mithilfe einer Zeitmaschine wollen die Chaoten durch die Zeit reisen, um die Zeugung ihres finsteren Chefs zu verhindern.
In dieser Sendung wird das große Peter-Orloff-Wunschkonzert für die Zuschauer präsentiert.

Zur Zeit des amerikanischen Bürgerkriegs: Der idealistische Südstaatenoffizier Brett schlägt sich nach Norden durch. Dort will er den berühmten Guerillaführer Quantrell unterstützen. Doch Quantrell entpuppt sich als ein machtgieriger Bandit.

Susanne Berger ist eine begabte Trompetenspielerin und tritt abends regelmäßig mit ihrem Freund Walter Pfeil im Duett im Jazzkeller Heißes Pflaster auf. Gerne würde Musikfernsehredakteur Herbert Petunius sie entdecken, darf seiner Chefin jedoch nur männliche Künstler zuarbeiten. In der Bar erscheint Susannes Cousine Monika, die in einem kleinen bayrischen Dorf wohnt und sich zum ersten Mal in die Großstadt getraut hat.

Die Trutzburg und die Burg Puechstein waren einst ein gemeinsames Gut. Damit die beiden Burgen wieder vereint werden, verloben die Edelherren ihre Kinder miteinander. Edelfräulein Hilda von Puechstein liebt aber einen einfachen Schäfer.

Entdecken Sie die geheime Welt der Büroverführung! In diesem aufregenden Film erleben Sie die geheime Leidenschaft, die in den Hallen der Unternehmen brodelt. Wenn die Geschäftswelt auf Sinnlichkeit trifft, gibt es keine Grenzen mehr.

Hinter der Kulisse des grauen Waldes aus Schornsteinen und Fördertürmen blüht für die Kumpel mit ungeahnter Vehemenz eine üppige Blume: der Sex! Der harte Lebensrhythmus ihres grauen Alltags heißt: Arbeit, Bier und Bett.

The feud between Phil and Gil Thorpe reaches a new level. A lice outbreak hits the family. Haley and Alex are trapped in the basement by a possum, and Manny and Gloria are embarrassed during a school field trip.
While Cam's thunder is stolen by a popular teacher's return, Mitch doesn't know what to make of his former college pal-turned-new boss.
A short clip from Rude Tube's incredibly naughty little sister Rude-ish Tube, featuring food and animals.

In East Kent, dinner party veterans Mike and Helenor kick off the competition, followed by Rob and Jade on day two who put together a Thai-inspired menu, and the last to host are visually impaired Caroline and her easy-going husband Tony.

Chef Ramsay heads to Cranbury, N.J., to help two friends who bought a French Bistro they used to work in. A disgusting discovery in a kitchen cooler forces Ramsay to shut the restaurant down on the busiest night of the year.

Manhattan's Black Pearl, a struggling seafood restaurant with three different owners running the kitchen, has come to chef Gordon Ramsay for help; one of the owners is resistant to change and questions every move Gordon makes.

Gordon visits Fleming, a Danish restaurant in Miami, Florida. It was once the best family-run restaurant in town, but now the place is on its last legs. Fleming was bought by husband and wife team Andy and Suzanne eight years ago, in the hope of continuing the restaurant's past success, but with no clue about Danish cuisine it's no real surprise the place is losing money. Can Gordon save their bacon?
Jay accidentally gatecrashes Mitch and Cam's evening out, and Luke befriends his crotchety old neighbour.
Cam accepts the role of music director at Luke and Manny's school, but his enthusiasm is far from infectious. Meanwhile, Jay's brother Donnie is in town.
When Mr Burns buys up all the media outlets in Springfield in an attempt to polish his image, Lisa starts her own newspaper.

After learning, he has narcolepsy, Homer gets drunk instead of going home with his medicine; a visit to a marriage counsellor leads to a trial separation for Homer and Marge; Homer dates a woman in her 20s.
Bart and Lisa are on the case when someone steals the smoker Homer bought from a mysterious man at a barbecue shack.
Twins Selma and Patti agree to give up smoking, but when Selma relapses after just 10 minutes, Patti moves in with Homer and Marge.
When Beverly receives last-minute mum coupons for Mother's Day, she feels upset. Elsewhere, Adam wants to go to space camp.

Barry's favourite shirt is hated by both his mother Beverly and his girlfriend Lainey, so they hatch a plan together to destroy it. But once the shirt goes missing, Barry asks Adam and Erica to investigate.

After closing on the sale of a house to Mitch and Cam's friends, Phil and Claire take the two of them out for a celebratory dinner where they proceed to over-indulge in drinks, which leads to some over-sharing, and finally results in waking up the next morning hung over and begging the question - if you'll do anything for family, shouldn't there still be a line drawn somewhere?
Phil realises that his little girl is growing up when he overhears something he wishes he hadn't about Haley. Meanwhile, Jay's ego takes a bruising.
With Cam's birthday falling but once every four years, the pressure is on Mitch to do something special. Emotions are running high over at the Dunphys' too.

Cameron reunites an old clown act despite Mitchell's warnings. Phil plays hardball with a rival to get a listing. Manny's new friend has a crush on Gloria. Claire wants her daughters to befriend her on Facebook.
After butchering a speech in front of all of his friends at work, Homer turns to improvisational comedy to gain back his confidence.
A jail sentence serves as a welcome break for Marge from her hectic life. In her absence, Homer struggles to hold down the fort.
Homer ends up with a superhero's physique after he is chosen to appear in a film based on a character created by Comic Book Guy.
Principal Skinner fires Mrs Krabappel after she makes a drunken fool of herself at the elementary school, but Skinner doesn't know that Bart spiked her coffee with alcohol.
Homer accepts a new job and moves the family to Cypress Creek, where the perfect setting soon turns sour.
The squad members demand that Jake repay all the money he has borrowed over the years, and Holt and Amy re-open a case.
A bank teller called Guy realises he is a background character in an open world video game called Free City that will soon go offline.

Having exhausted Cornwall's dating pool, Millie hopes to finally wave goodbye to laid-back surfers. And Alex the window cleaner seeks someone who'll take a shine to his fit body.
Self-confessed 'dating disaster' Katie, from Bristol, is looking to turn her luck around. Also, student James has a thing for heels and glitter and hopes to meet an open-minded guy.

Security guard AJ is looking for 'a firm woman' and tries to impress a podium dancer Paige. Kitchen designer Kerry has a date with a fellow northerner Ryan who is trying to laugh her into bed, and software designer Mark faces spiritual Sophia.
Jeff Dudan, founder and CEO of AdvantaClean, goes undercover to tackle mould and water damage in a client's home.
John Fuller, the new president and CEO of a speciality coffee and tea retailer, acts as an employee to meet those who keep his company running.

South African-born Nigel, and his wife Nikki, kick off the competition in South Wales. Day two sees Darren and Simon attempt to woo their guests with a flavour of their first-class lifestyle, and finally it's Neil and Carly's chance to impress.

In Aberdeen, aspiring singer Lek and footballer boyfriend Josh kick off the competition with an Asian/West Indian fusion menu. Day two sees Ange and Davie hoping to impress with an Australian-themed night, and last to host are Jennifer and Jason.
Laid-back Daniel fancies a Caribbean street parade for his nuptials, while Sabrina dreams of a more traditional event. Will their big day be carnage or carnival?
Beauty queen and bride-to-be Yasmin has her heart set on a fairytale wedding. Powerlifter Yiannis tries to deliver her dream nuptials.
The buyers hope to land late-night treasures in Huntington Beach, California. Darrell and Brandon look for great lockers on their home turf, and Dave seeks a score or a sucker.
Rene brings his father, Gunter, to the auction festivities in Montebello, California. Instigators Darrell and Brandon get sneaky, Ivy forges on despite an injury, and Dave eyes a big score.
Ground-breaking model, author and body activist Ashley Graham dons a disguise to go undercover and encounter aspiring dreamers hoping to break through into the fashion world.
Grammy-winning singer and songwriter Seal goes undercover to find undiscovered talented musicians struggling to make it in the music industry.
Nine of the season's top winners compete for a $100,000 prize; a musical tribute to funny kissing clips; a woman who can't find her car in a car park, even though it is right in front of her.
Ivy gambles on his own party locker, Brandi and Jarrod return to basics, and Rene receives advice on his presentation.
Mary finally locates a vintage goodie in El Monte, California. Ivy uncovers decades-old family fun, and Darrell revisits a childhood pastime.

Fraser begins to question his long-distance relationship. Rainbeau tries to connect with Barbara and Solene. Caio's shortcomings as bosun are playing on Captain Kerry's mind. And Kyle and Solene go on a date.
Gordon Ramsay tries to help a husband and wife in Chicago with their Café 36 restaurant, which is losing money due to a lack of clientele and a head chef who isn't concerned with quality.
Chef Ramsay tries to help two inexperienced restaurant owners who run an Italian eatery called Casa Roma in Lancaster, Calif.

Jimmy Carr hosts, while Sean Lock and Roisin Conaty take on guest captain Sarah Millican and Rhod Gilbert. David O'Doherty joins Dictionary Corner with Susie Dent, while Rachel Riley takes care of the numbers and letters.
Dad's Birthday: Dad has the birthday blues - not only has he worked out the date he's going to die, but then 'Horrible Grandma' turns up uninvited. Can Jim's magic do the trick?
Jim sets up a giant dog cage for Milson in the Goodmans' living room, and Aunty Val's got a hot date with a 'sex robot'.
Two episodes remain in the series and with Greg Davies's shiny head trophy within touching distance, tensions are beginning to run high between the contestants.

The teams discuss and dissect the topics that set the Great British public's chins wagging. Team captains Rob and Aisling are joined by Chris Kamara, Murder in Successville's Tom Davis and comedians James Acaster and Tiff Stevenson.
The Royal Palace of Caserta near Naples, Italy, which was created by Luigi Vanvitelli and houses a silk factory that dates back to the 18th century.
Michael Portillo is on Northern Ireland's spectacular Causeway Coast to begin a railway journey that takes him along the north and east coasts of Ireland through the provinces of Ulster and Leinster.
Henry Cole and Max McMurdo travel the length of Britain seeking items to fix up and flog. In Wales, picks include an oil dispenser, a chaise longue and a catamaran.
Henry Cole and Simon O'Brien are in Northamptonshire and Coventry, where Henry discovers a very rare limited edition Goldwing motorbike with only 65 miles on the clock.
Henry Cole and Simon O'Brien head to Northamptonshire in search of their latest upcycling prospects. Simon finds some night vision goggles and an antique snooker table that's seen better days.
Henry Cole and Simon O'Brien turn an old, unloved filing cabinet into a valuable and desirable storage unit, and they convert a Bakelite voltmeter into a retro Bluetooth speaker.
Laughter and music courtesy of Ronnie Barker and Ronnie Corbett, and special guest Elaine Paige. Sketches include Tinker Tailor Smiley Doyle, Private Lives and Pismonouncers Unanimous.
The bespectacled comedy legends from 1983 with sketches including Bushman's Holiday and Raiders of the Last Auk. Elaine Paige provides the musical relief.
Stalwarts of comedy Ronnie Barker and Ronnie Corbett offer up more rib-tickling skits. Highlights include 'Big Blue Book' and 'Party Lines'. Patricia Routledge is among the guests.
More wry skits and puntastic comedy from Ronnies B and C. Sketches include Filling In, Martial Arts, and Office Quickie.

An ageing movie queen yearns so badly to return to the glamour of show business that she plans the demise of her husband with laughing gas.
Dr Sloan must prove the innocence of a wife who stands accused of killing her husband with laughing gas.

Jessica travels to Hollywood in an effort to stop a sleazy producer from turning one of her novels into a steamy film. When the movie mogul turns up dead, she is horrified to learn that she is the chief suspect.
While visiting a country cousin, a hunting accident in which he is killed sets Jessica off on another investigation.
When a surprise threatens to spoil Castle and Beckett's wedding day, they must set out on a wild mission filled with masked men and angry bikers.

When a group of criminals hijacks a plane and lands on the Reef, Cat jumps into action formulating a quick-thinking plan to save the passengers on board before it's too late.
Mary helps her latest witness, a homeless man who's struggling with a more conventional lifestyle, find his birth mother. Meanwhile, Brandi is worries about Scott's request for more money.
Master sleuth Aurora Teagarden must find a copycat killer who targets members of a crime-buff club.

A police officer faces a paranormal nightmare when he responds to a 911 call from a distressed homeowner; a first responder questions his sanity after he sees the ghost of a young accident victim in his home.
