A friendly ghost influences Stephen to end his marriage, while a malicious ghost makes Chris decide to move.
Lesley is traumatised when her father doesn't believe she's seen a ghost, while young Lance's family takes it in their stride when he sees a phantom in an old dormitory.
Two people who have been to the other side tell of the supernatural experiences surrounding their own deaths.
Barbara and Elsie both get ghostly messages from their long-dead fathers, and those messages save their mothers' lives.
Alex turns to Catholic icons for safety when he is faced with horrifying supernatural threats. Meanwhile, Susan goes to unusual lengths to keep her protective rosary close.
Their spouses died, but didn't leave. Fred and Pansy continue to have a ghostly relationship with their dead wife and husband.
They both drowned as children and both were revived. And ever since, Karyn and Douglas have been able to see and talk to ghosts.

A couple accidentally invites spirits into their home when they decorate their nursery; Julie Stuart falls in love with an antique dresser that turns out to be haunted; a couple opens the door for a dangerous spirit with a shocking identity.

A terrifying creature with 1,000 teeth torments Allison Gilson's son; a young boy makes an imaginary friend but discovers it's not the only entity lurking in their new home; a ghost uses a boy to get to his mother.

A poltergeist haunts Kristine McKee's new home and gets physical with her son; a friend's past life comes back to haunt Danielle Low with potentially life-threatening results; a paranormal entity attacks a woman, leaving her black and blue.

The APRA collaborate with the mayor of West Point, Kentucky to investigate of the riverside town. The team assesses paranormal activity in two purportedly haunted locations: the Lynch House and Hardy Hotel.

APRA ambitiously conducts its most ambitious investigation to date, a full-scale paranormal experiment during a once-in-a-lifetime eclipse in two West Point, KY paranormal hotspots rife with claims, Fort Duffield and the Ditto House.
Study a strange physical scratch that could be linked to a haunting love story.
Visit Morrison Lodge, a Masonic hall where spectres often roam the corridors.

A firefighter experiences ghostly phenomena at an amusement park. A police officer encounters a dark entity that may be the cause of multiple fatalities on a notoriously dangerous stretch of highway known as the Coffin Corridor.
Lives of the Caesars (121 AD) gives 12 bios of Rome's rulers from the early Empire.
Explore the 3rd century crisis, the rise of Constantine, and the ultimate fall of the Western Roman Empire.

Explores the truth behind the scandalous stories about Rome's fifth emperor, Nero. Was he truly as cruel as depicted in history? What was his governance style? How did he contribute to architectural development?

Engineers digging for Crossrail have made a chilling discovery: dozens of skulls under London's Liverpool Street station. It's clear the skulls are from Roman London, but nothing like this has been found before.
Explore Stalin's life, trials and tribulations during the rise of the Soviet Union.

The Russian Revolution in 1917 changed the course of history. Two families go to war, Lenin's Ulyanovs and the Tsar's Romanovs. With assassinations, popular revolt, and a daring seizure of power, the twentieth century is changed forever.

Vladimir Putin is the modern face of dictatorship, rising out of the ashes of the chaotic Yeltsin years. In the 90s, Putin was a relatively unknown figure who would go on to occupy an untouchable position in a country spanning 11 time zones.

Castro has outlived generations of US Presidents, Soviet General Secretaries, CIA Directors and would-be assassins. This film offers a psychological profile of the Cuban revolutionary, and a deeply intimate account of his life based on private letters, correspondence, speeches and interviews. It features interviews with some of Fidel Castro's closest relatives, close friends and committed enemies.
Cuban revolutionaries Frank País and José Antonio Echeverría play critical roles in the overthrow of Fulgencio Batista.
The Tea Party sparked the American Revolution, driven by politics, trade, and colonial mismanagement.
On April 6, 1862, the Confederate force's surprise attack against the Union in Shiloh, Tenn., results in some of the most brutal fighting of the Civil War.

Gen. Ulysses S. Grant's counter-attack at Shiloh, Tenn., leads to victory; thousands of escaping slaves seek refuge with Union forces advancing into the South; President Abraham Lincoln begins drafting a proclamation addressing slavery and freedom.

The Emancipation Proclamation ends slavery and gives blacks the freedom to fight; on July 4, 1863, the day after Pickett's Charge at Gettysburg, the Confederates surrender Vicksburg, Miss., to Gen. Grant.

The Confederate Army of Northern Virginia succeeds at splitting the Union Army in two during the Battle of Chickamauga; Gen. William Rosecrans is replaced by Gen. Ulysses S. Grant, who plans an offensive.
The Confederate Army falls to a defensive position in Atlanta; President Abraham Lincoln defeats challenger George McClellan; Sherman's March to the Sea.

Professor Alice Roberts explores 2018's best archaeological finds from the east of the UK: a monument as old as Stonehenge, a dig at the site of Britain's first tank battle, and some disturbing Roman burials.

Hugh Dennis and the team search for the remains of a vanished building in the gardens of the Georgian stately home Beningbrough Hall. In the grounds of the house, the team looks for evidence of the 17th-century gardens that once stood here.

Hugh and the team search for the remains of a Norman motte-and-bailey castle in the suburb of West Derby in Liverpool. Over 900 years ago this impressive fortress would have been home to Norman lords.

In 1323 BCE, Egypt was plunged into chaos following Akhenaten's attempted revolution. Paramessu, who had proven himself in the military field, succeeded Horemheb. The Ramesside dynasty was poised to rule.
After Horemheb's death, his deputy Paramessou became pharaoh, assuming the name Ramses I.

Alice Roberts follows the excavation of Iron Age Britain's most spectacular grave. A team of archaeologists in East Yorkshire have uncovered the remains of only the third upright chariot burial ever found in Britain.

A secret location in the Cotswolds, with all the hallmarks of a high-status Anglo-Saxon cemetery, gives up a very precious and fragile artefact. And at the site of Shaftesbury Abbey, Dr Naoise MacSweeney joins archaeologist Julian Richards in his hunt for the missing cloister.
The final words of a lifelong gold hunter send Adam, Kru and Daryl Friesen through an icy gauntlet high above Pitt Lake.
An old map connected to testimony from an 1891 eyewitness account of Slumach's hanging sheds light on the legend.
Tony Robinson visits the Cairngorms National Park to discover how Queen Victoria and Prince Albert helped to shape Scottish traditions and imagery such as tartan, bagpipes and caber tossing.

The dramatic moors and valleys of West Yorkshire are the setting for an unusual slice of the past in Tony Robinson's first walk from this new series. This evocative landscape was the home of, and inspiration for, the Brontes, the remarkable literary family that produced Wuthering Heights and Jane Eyre.

Hugh and the team take on their first-ever prehistoric dig as they try to unearth ancient roundhouses in the village of Stretton in Staffordshire. Their mission is to work out just how far back in time the settlement dates.

Dr Alice Roberts looks at some excavations that offer a different perspective on the Vikings. She searches in the Outer Hebrides and Orkney for early Viking settlements. The Viking chief's citadel reveals information about their way of life.
Archaeological finds from Roman Britannia include 97 baby skeletons buried near the Thames, a town in rural Devon, and a Roman cult figure that remained buried beneath a fort for 1700 years.

After the death of Seti I, a monumental reign begins: that of Ramesses II. From the beginning, he asserts his unique style, and expresses a strong desire for the restoration of Egypt's greatness and territorial expansion.

After five years of reigning, Ramses the Great had already earned the distinction of being the most feared and respected among the martial pharaohs. He personally led his army with the aim of reconquering the kingdoms of the Levant.

Amanda Holden and Dan Jones shine a light on the most seductive sex stories from the 20th Century. Amanda talks to Virginia Nicholson about the advent of the birth control pill, while Dr Kate Lister talks to Dan about the UK adult film industry.

Looking at attitudes to sex before the intervention of Christianity. Amanda trains as a Spartan woman and then discovers the influence of the Kama Sutra today, while Dan visits Chelsea Physic Garden to recreate Ancient Egyptian sexual medicines.

Zusammen mit Angela Kinsey wird es herzhaft: Dr. Pepper BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwiches, gefüllte Ofenkartoffeln, Maiskolben mit gebratener Jalapeño-Knoblauch-Butter und ein süßer Pfirsich-Cobbler machen den Abend zu einem texanischen Highlight.

Joanna zaubert köstliche süße und herzhafte Frühstücksgerichte wie Grünkohl-Bacon-Kartoffelgratin, French Toast Crunch, Knoblauch-Käse-Grits und einen gemixten Pfirsich-Sonnenaufgang. Ein perfektes Menü für den Start in den Tag.

Joanna kreiert ein gemütliches Friendsgiving-Essen: ein reichhaltiger Auflauf, begleitet von herzhafter Preiselbeersauce und knusprigen grünen Bohnen Amandine. Als süßer Abschluss begeistert ein fruchtiger Kirsch-Mandel-Crisp.

Jenni Yolo designt die Küche eines Freundes und lässt dabei seine venezolanischen Wurzeln mit einfließen. Während sie gemeinsam töpfern, wagt das Team ein Design-Experiment, bei dem Rückwand und Wandgestaltung auf völlig neue Weise verschmelzen.

Ben und Erin gestalten den Hinterhof eines historischen Hauses mit einem Pool und hübschen Kunstatelier für umzugsfreudige Freunde. Sie wollen eine Oase schaffen, die die Familie davon überzeugt, sich endgültig niederzulassen.
Ben und Erin gestalten das Cottage einer Künstlerin und ehemaligen Managerin, die selbst Interior Designerin ist.

Eine Frau verabschiedet sich vom pulsierenden Leben in New Orleans und sucht in einer Kleinstadt nach mehr Ruhe. Dennoch soll ihr neues Zuhause Platz für Gäste, Musik und kreative Entfaltung bieten. Ben und Erin greifen ihre musikalische Vergangenheit auf und integrieren diese sensibel in das Design.

Der 25-jährige Jemarcus ist in Laurel als Sportler und Trainer gut bekannt. Jetzt möchte er sein erstes Haus kaufen und wendet sich an seine alten Bekannten Ben und Erin. Die beiden haben 150.000 Dollar zur Verfügung und zwei tolle Häuser.

Cliff und Nadine wohnen seit 16 Jahren in ihrem Haus und möchten ihr Zuhause endlich renovieren lassen. Die Küche sowie das Wohn- und Esszimmer sind voneinander abgetrennt. Christina möchte das ändern und einen offenen Bereich schaffen. Die Handwerker entfernen den Kamin, ein Fenster und alle Wände, die die Räume trennen. Die Küche kann somit vergrößert und mit einer Kücheninsel ausgestattet werden. Zudem wird der Boden ausgetauscht und neue Möbel werden platziert.

Dieses Projekt ist für Christina besonders persönlich - denn ihre neueste Kundschaft ist niemand Geringeres als ihre eigenen Eltern. Die beiden möchten das Haus, in dem Christina aufgewachsen ist, einer umfassenden Verwandlung unterziehen.

Für eine junge Familie mit kleinem Budget erweitert Christina das Schlafzimmer zu einem gemütlichen Raum und gestaltet eine funktionale und stilvolle Küche. Sie findet sogar für die Surfbretter, die oft im Weg stehen, den perfekten Stauraum.
Christina übernimmt das Haus eines Paares, das voller seltsamer Ecken und nicht genutzter Räume ist.

Brian und Mika Kleinschmidt bringen neue Teamkollegen mit, um den Raum zu renovieren, der den ersten und letzten Eindruck des Hotels darstellt: die Lobby. Team Mika hat keine Lobby und muss eine von Grund auf neu bauen, will aber gewinnen.

Brian und Mika Kleinschmidt holen zwei talentierte Designer ins Boot, um einen der wichtigsten Bereiche des Hotels auf Vordermann zu bringen: die Küchenzeile. Hier entscheidet sich, ob Gäste sich wohlfühlen - oder nicht. Während die Bauarbeiten Fahrt aufnehmen, steigt auch die Spannung: Die beiden Designerteams liegen mit jeweils einem Sieg gleichauf, und der Wettbewerb um das beste Konzept wird immer hitziger!

In den vergangenen Jahren haben sich immer mehr US-Amerikaner dazu entschieden, sich ein Leben fernab der Zivilisation aufzubauen. Marty Raney, Tochter Misty und Sohn Matt wollen den Aussteigern das nötige Know-how mit auf den Weg geben.

Jeff Deeter und seine Frau Katti leben als Hundeschlittenführer mitten in der Wildnis. Dort kämpfen sie täglich um das Überleben. Um gegen die häufigen Waldbrände und hungrigen Bären gewappnet zu sein, bekommen sie Tipps von den Raneys.

Eine Familie bittet Cappie und Alex, ihrem alten Getreidespeicher neues Leben einzuhauchen. Mit Liebe zum Detail verwandeln sie das Erbstück in einen zauberhaften Rückzugsort. Das luxuriöse Interieur kombiniert modernen Komfort mit rustikalem Charme.

Cappie und Alex entwerfen ein individuell bewegliches Gewächshaus, sodass die Pflanzen unabhängig von den Wetterbedingungen in South Dakota gedeihen können. So vereint das Gewächshaus optimalen Schutz und unterschiedliche Standorte.

Die Freundinnen D'Arcy Carden und Sherry Cola erkunden einige der verrücktesten Ferienunterkünfte im Zentrum der USA. Ihre Reise führt sie in ein Haus rund um das Thema Rennsport, eine gemütliche Höhlenunterkunft und ein ehemaliges Raketensilo.

D'Arcy Carden und Sherry Cola machen sich im Südosten der USA auf die Suche nach außergewöhnlichen Ferienunterkünften. Sie entdecken eine Hütte im Kamera-Design, ein marokkanisch inspiriertes Baumhaus und eine rund 18 Meter hohe, autarke Oase.

In Texas suchen D'Arcy Carden und Sherry Cola nach den wildesten Ferienunterkünften des Bundesstaates. Dabei besuchen sie ein weitläufiges Ranch-Resort, ein kunstvolles Haus ohne Ecken und eine riesige Lodge mit außergewöhnlichen Baumhäusern.

Martin Roberts meets one of two young brothers busy building a property portfolio in Bolsover, Derbyshire, while Dion Dublin checks out a three-bedroom semi in Wolverhampton, and Lucy Alexander is impressed by plans to convert a two-bedroom, fire-damaged terraced house in London's Plaistow into a smart five-bedroom property.

Dion Dublin has a hair-raising experience at a barber's in Rochdale, Lancashire, while Martin Roberts looks round a great bungalow in Alsager, Cheshire, and Lucy Alexander sees all the potential in a piece of land in Eccles in Kent.

Martin Roberts visits a house in Otterton, Devon, which is given a stunning transformation to match the views from the windows; Lucy Alexander looks round a small one-bedroom flat in Tottenham, London; and Dion Dublin peers into a building in Alvaston, Derby, which is in a dangerous state of disrepair.

Lucy Alexander is in Welling in the London Borough of Bexley looking round a three-bed semi in need of lots of work, Dion Dublin is in Basford, Nottingham, where a three-bedroom terraced house also requires a major revamp, and Martin Roberts hears plans from a father-and-son team who plan to knock down their auction property in Callington, Cornwall, and start again.
Martin Roberts, Lucy Alexander and Dion Dublin visit a one-bedroom flat in Catford, London, a large house near the River Mersey and a semi-detached property in Alvaston in Derby.

An end-terrace house in Alfreton in Derby bought by two brothers, a mid-terrace on the coast at Seaham in County Durham and a large three-storey property with a flat and shop in Taylorstown in the Rhondda Valley are all sold at auction. Martin Roberts, Lucy Alexander and Dion Dublin talk to the new owners to find out what they have planned for their auction buys.

Martin Roberts falls in love with a quirky cottage in Malvern bought by a builder and his wife, Dion Dublin talks to a first-time property developer who sees her end-terrace house in Chell in Stoke-on-Trent as something for her pension pot, and Lucy Alexander meets a divorced couple who have decided to form a new union as property developers doing up a shop and flat in Dover, Kent.

A large piece of land in Ratby in Leicestershire, a terrace in Chesterton in Staffordshire and a 1930s semi with a huge garden and huge potential are all sold at auction. Martin Roberts, Lucy Alexander and Dion Dublin meet the developers hoping to breathe new life into their auction buys.

A two-bedroom detached house in Basford in Nottingham, a top-floor flat in Portsmouth and a large Edwardian terrace in Crewe are all sold under the hammer. Martin, Lucy and Dion meet the new owners and hear about their plans.

A multimillion-pound development in Farningham in Kent, an ambitious, total renovation project in Aspatria in Cumbria and a very small studio flat in Wallington in Surrey are all sold under the hammer. Martin and Lucy meet the new owners to discuss their plans.

A Victorian terrace in London's Greenwich, two flats in Chatham in Kent and a riverside inn near Great Yarmouth in Norfolk are all sold under the hammer. Martin Roberts, Lucy Alexander and Dion Dublin meet the new owners and hear plans for their renovation projects.
A three-bedroom house in Borrowash in Derbyshire, another three-bedder in West Bromwich in the Midlands and a quirky four-bedroom house on the Isle of Sheppey are all sold under the hammer.

A flat in Pegswood in Northumberland, a terrace in Swadlincote in Derbyshire and a former shop in Chatham in Kent are all sold under the hammer. Martin Roberts, Lucy Alexander and Dion Dublin meet the new owners and hear their renovation plans.

Lucy meets a young couple expecting a baby who have to weigh up whether to live in their auction buy in Sydenham in London. Martin talks to a man and his father-in-law who have bought their first property together in Trentham near Stoke. Also, Dion meets a man who only went into property development after he retired. His latest buy is a three-bed semi in West Bromwich.
A mid-terrace house in Wales, a basement office in Central London with a huge price tag and two flats in Bootle near Liverpool are all sold under the hammer.

Terraced houses in Tunstall in Shropshire and Prescott in Liverpool and a large flat in Dagenham are all sold under the hammer. Martin, Lucy and Dion have a look round before hearing what the new owners have planned.

A chiropodist, two part-time gardeners and a woman who works on projects in between the school run are today's investors. They've bought property in Bullbridge in Derbyshire, Newcastle-under-Lyme in Staffordshire and Wolverhampton in the West Midlands under the hammer.

Hosts Madiha Naqvi and Shafaat Ali get weekday mornings going, featuring a combination of news, stories of the day, and covering other important issues, with key figures from all around the world.

It's Earth Day and Paddington has the important job of planting a tree. He has to find the perfect spot before it is too late. Baaz holds a spring harvest festival and everyone enjoys bringing their own celebration along.

Who is Paddington's Special Visitor that Jonathan and Judy have helped come from afar? It's the last night of Hanukkah and Mr Gruber's Hanukkiah breaks before he can light the final candle, how can another be found in time?
Mrs Brown can't find inspiration for her next artwork, so Paddington decides to help find her mojo. Jonathan and Paddington dig up some broken pottery that turns out to be a statue made by Mrs Brown.
Peppa and George play in their pool, helping garden animals cool off. When rain arrives, both the animals and Peppa are pleased. The rainfall forms muddy puddles, which Peppa loves for jumping.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa Pig's garden, where Granny's friends are playing folk music. After they perform for Grandpa Pig, he treats everyone to freshly made apple juice.
It is bedtime and Peppa calls Kylie Kangaroo and is surprised to learn that it is not morning or winter where she is! Daddy Pig explains this using a big ball to represent the Earth.

While visiting Suzy and Emily's house, Peppa is surprised that there are extra rules which she does not have in her own house. On the drive home, Peppa explains to Mummy Pig that different houses have different rules.
Clarion and Annette help Dr Talon with a special patient. Snowed in at the Clinic, the trainees help Ariel celebrate new traditions.
Rubble moves with his family of construction pups to the nearby town of Builder Cove where they live, play and build whatever the community needs.

The Pups rescue Sweetie when she sneaks into the Hidden Jungle and finds a mysterious orb which causes everything she touches to turn to gold; the Pups must save a colony of giant ants from destroying the Hidden Jungle and themselves.
Tim and Tommy help out at the Diner Store, bringing some joy and chaos to the diner.
When Grandma gives Tim a hat she made herself, Tim is super excited, but unfortunately it keeps getting in the way.
The Rex family go on a long road trip through the galaxy to get to Rocket World.
When three of Blaze's friends get launched into outer space on out-of-control jetpacks, Astronauts Blaze and AJ must blast off to save them!
There's a new Gabby Cat in town: Marty the Party Cat! Gabby and Pandy show Marty all the fun features in the party room to make him feel welcome.
Snooty King and Queen Marigold invite themselves round for dinner to King and Queen Thistle's Castle to sample Nanny Plum's cooking. Nanny tries very hard to cook special modern food.
Things are going missing all over the Little Kingdom - Holly has lost her wand and Ben has lost his horn! Soon they realise that ants are stealing their things.

Peppa and her family go on a day trip to visit the Windy Castle. Mummy Pig drives, while Daddy Pig reads the map. When they reach the destination, Peppa and George spot Granny and Grandpa Pig's house.
Peppa's older cousin Chloe comes to visit, and Peppa must play games by somebody else's rules for a change.
When it comes to pancake making, Daddy Pig thinks he is a bit of an expert, but he has a tendency to flip the pancakes a bit too high.
Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig are going out for the evening. Granny and Grandpa Pig babysit Peppa and George. They are too excited to sleep. When Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig get home everyone is asleep.

Peppa goes to her first ballet lesson, and meets her friends Candy, Suzy, Rebecca, Danny and Pedro there. She decides to teach Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig to dance but finds out they have some moves of their own.
Peppa and George are playing in the garden when they hear a strange noise. It's thunder. Peppa and George are a little bit frightened at first but Peppa soon decides that she loves thunderstorms.
Daddy Pig is taking everyone for a drive in the country, but the car is very muddy and Mummy insists they wash it first.
When the family goes to Granny and Grandpa Pig's house for dinner, George is reluctant to eat his salad.
Storm claims to be scared of nothing, but is that true? What happens to Hefty when his shadow tries to free itself from him?
The pups are on a mission to stop Jake's chalet from sliding downhill before it crashes; While messing with a satellite dish, the Mayor interrupts the town's communication systems.

Chickaletta is left driving the train after an enormous chicken floaty launches Engineer Ed out the window. When Katie needs to close the Pet Parlour early, Digi and Tal volunteer to keep the shop open.
Hope makes lots of noise whilst skateboarding, and her howls are heard around the city causing lots of drama. The Twins manage the Smoothie Bar and the Marsups end up creating the best smoothie ever.
Mr Elf has built a new boat to replace the one Big Bad Barry ate. He is nervous when the king commands him to take them on a cruise to a tropical paradise.
Ben, Holly and Gaston the Ladybird find a large egg in the meadow. A tiny chick hatches from the egg and the children must find the mummy bird.
Snobby King and Queen Marigold are coming to visit the Little Kingdom, and Holly and her Mummy and Daddy enlist the Elf Band to impress them.
King Leopold has announced he is paying a visit to The Little Kingdom. Everyone is very excited that they have a VIP coming to The Little Kingdom and prepare to welcome him in style.
Tim attempts to distract Tia whilst Tusky is being washed in the machine.
The kids become the parents and the parents become the kids.
Tim tests new rocket boots, which quickly spiral out of control.
Stan and Gran are enjoying a beach clean, but the rubbish seems to have a mind of its own! When a yoghurt pot goes walk-about, Stan spies a mystery!
The bats that nest in Grandad's shed each year are missing. Can Stan and Gran encourage these nocturnal creatures to return when they can't hear them?
An air collie makes an unlikely friend. The Creature Catchers try a new ploy.
While at a playgroup with Madame Gazelle, Peppa and her friends learn all about the weather by building themselves a Weather Station, complete with thermometer, wind turbine and rain collector.
Peppa helps out with Danny Dog refurbishing his bedroom, and imagines a pirate adventure along the way.
There's a new friend for Peppa at her playgroup, Lotte Lama. She can speak a foreign language, and Peppa loves talking. Everyone loves talking.
Mr Bull builds a brand-new clubhouse and slide for Peppa and her friends.

Uncle Otis accidentally slips and tosses Julia and Julius's new goldfish, Marigold, into the river! When Ms. Marjorie and Mr. Park don wing suits to see a rare flower, a flying squirrel sends them off course!

Cat-Pack members Wild and Shade team up with the Mighty Pups to stop a runaway rocket. When the Ruff-Ruff Pack swipes a priceless golden lion mask from the museum, Wild and Shade must help the PAW Patrol retrieve the stolen artefact.
A glowing lantern leads Gabby and Pandy to a Fairy Fly House; however, to meet their new neighbour, they'll need to prove they're helpful, kind and welcoming.
It is a special day because Mummy and Daddy Pig have big news to tell Peppa and George, but they struggle to wait!
Peppa eagerly awaits her new sibling, growing impatient with the lengthy wait. Suddenly, Mummy Pig announces that the baby is coming right now.
With the building work complete, it's time to decorate! Peppa and George have fun choosing how to decorate their new attic bedrooms. It's dinosaurs for George, but what will Peppa pick?
Peppa and George play with walkie-talkies at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house. Grandpa Pig teaches Peppa and George how to use codenames to talk using the gadgets.
Daddy Piggy arrives in an electric car. The family go out and are surprised when the car talks.

Peppa and George are watching a television show about Detective Potato and how he helps people find things. Daddy needs to buy some gravel so Peppa and George go with him. They park the car in a very large car park, but when they return, they can't remember where they parked it. Police Officer Panda and Police Officer Squirrel arrive to help Daddy Pig but have no luck. Suddenly, Detective Potato appears and saves the day.

It is raining, and Grandpa Rabbit has built a rocket pack. As he demonstrates it to Peppa and George, he inadvertently ends up atop a snowy mountain. Miss Hare attempts to rescue him but becomes stranded on the mountaintop as well.

Doctor Hamster comes to school to talk about butterflies. Doctor Hamster shows the children some colourful caterpillars and all the children draw pictures of caterpillars. One caterpillar forms a chrysalis that opens to reveal a pretty butterfly. The children paint butterfly wings and dance the life cycle of a butterfly.
King Thistle has a cold and needs some medicine. Nanny Plum, Holly, and Ben, have a lot of fun collecting the ingredients to make a magic potion to cure his cold and make him better.
King Thistle wants bread for his royal breakfast, but there isn't any flour in the castle. Mr Elf takes everyone to the Elf Windmill to find out why it takes so long to make flour.

When Cranky gets overwhelmed, he accidentally gets Riff and Jiff's names confused and sends them on silly deliveries. Though Thomas hears the mistakes, he doesn't correct the crane, a decision that creates chaos in Sodor.
When Thomas, Percy, and Diesel take in a stray sheep, the engines get a little more than they bargained for when the fluffy creature and her herd overstay their welcome in the sheds.
When Tim and Kai have a rare disagreement, they each try to find a new best friend.
Join Tim Rex as he tackles kid-shaped problems with dino-sized solutions in space! Tim, Kai and Tommy try to get their ball back from Mum's bedroom.
Tim, Tommy, and Tia take on their parents at Tailball.
A superfood cake creates some superheroes. Paddington wants to become a Knight.
Peppa and her friends, accompanied by Mummy Sheep and Granny Sheep, take Vanessa to Grampy Rabbit's boatyard for inspiration. The children create various artworks using items found around the yard.
While Mummy and Daddy Pig attend a refresher antenatal class, Peppa and George join Miss Rabbit's Sibling School where they learn about what to expect when their new sibling arrives.
The Pig family go to the hospital, where Peppa is determined to find the perfect name for the baby.
The nurse visits and decides to focus on teaching proper baby-holding techniques. She demonstrates a safe method for a small person, like Peppa, to hold an infant correctly.
George undergoes a medical examination to assess his hearing. The results of the test reveal moderate hearing loss in his left ear, marking an important milestone in his health and development.
Peppa is excited to help George explore the world of sounds now he has his hearing aid. She shows him her favourite sounds including the splashing of jumping in a muddy puddle!
Grandpa Pig and Grandad Dog are on their boats when Grandpa Pig drops an anchor on his foot! After an x-ray and plaster cast at the hospital, Grandpa Pig needs to stay overnight.
Grandpa Pig finds his night at the hospital so comfortable, he's reluctant to be discharged. Papa and Suzy volunteer to nurse him at home and make sure he's just as comfortable as he was in hospital.
It's the day of Penny Polar Bear's party and the children find out they will be playing ice hockey! They are kitted out in safety gear at the ice rink and have great fun learning to play.
Mr Meerkat shows the children a huge wall that needs painting. They create a fantastic mural using lots of different techniques: brushes, sponges, buggy ropes and even a paint cannon!
It's the day of the duck race! When Miss Rabbit gives the sign, everyone drops their ducks in the river at the first bridge - whose will make it to the second bridge first?
Nanny Plum and The Wise Old Elf each think they work harder than the other. King Thistle commands them to swap for the day to find out.
Ben and Holly visit the beehive to see how honey is made. Wise Old Elf is the beekeeper, and he proceeds to show the children his special way of collecting honey.
Mrs Kangaroo takes everyone on an amazing adventure under the sea in her submarine to see the Great Barrier Reef.
Sadly, Peppa and her family's holiday in Australia is coming to an end, but they still have time to play with a boomerang and make friends with Mr Wallaby.

Madame Gazelle and the playgroup are sharing their favourite nursery rhymes. From singing Little Bo Peep to marching along with The Grand Old Duke of York, everyone enjoys listening to each other's choice.
Peppa's family are at Digger World, where they have fun building walls and knocking them over again, and even help Mr Bull when there's an obstacle in the road.
Peppa and George play at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house. Grandma, Peppa and George go to the shed to see what Grandpa is doing and discover that he's built a robot.
Peppa's playgroup is holding a jumble sale to raise money for a new roof and Madame Gazelle asks everyone to bring something to sell. Peppa and each of her friends bring in an old toy.
Peppa and her family are at the swimming pool. George is a little worried at first but is soon splashing happily with his friend Richard Rabbit.
Peppa and George are playing in Grandpa Pig's garden when they find a little snail.
Peppa and George visit Daddy Pig's office and meet his colleagues. Mr Rabbit works with numbers, while Mrs Cat seems to spend her time drawing shapes on a computer.
Paddington and Robot Paddington enjoy being heroes, Paddington discovers how to be calm.

Siblings Shovel and Pail can't agree on an ending for their storybook; when they get so upset that they stop talking to each other, it's up to Josh and Blue to figure out a way to get them to resolve the conflict.
Wandy gets a cold and is taken ill; Holly is given a replacement wand. This new wand can do lots of things that Wandy can't, and soon becomes the favourite.
The children are playing a game of superheroes. When Strawberry takes her super villain role a bit too far, it is up to the 'Elf Man' and 'Fairy Girl' to save the day.
Ben, Holly and Nanny Plum help Mrs Witch have a bit of a clear-out. The children bring the magical items back home, but in the wrong hands, they cause a few problems.
It is harvest day. The elves and fairies enlist the help of Mr Gnome in picking blackberries. If only they could stop him from eating them all.

Grandpa and Granny Pig take Peppa, George and all their friends on a boat trip to Pirate Island. On the island, Grandpa shows everyone how to use his metal detector to find treasure, and they all build a big sandcastle.

Peppa and George love jumping in muddy puddles, even when it's raining, but when George takes off his rain hat he catches a cold. After plenty of rest and some warm milk and honey, George begins to feel much better.
Peppa and family are at the school fair where the top prize in the raffle is a hot-air balloon ride.
The family have a special day planned for George's birthday. They visit the museum and see dinosaurs, before ending the day with cake.
Suzy Sheep has come to play with Peppa, and has made up a pretend friend called 'Leo Lion'. Peppa can't see Leo, but Suzy announces that Leo likes roaring and playing dressing up.
Peppa, George and Daddy are in the garden painting a picture of a cherry tree when the ducks turn up and run through the paint, and all over their masterpiece.
Grandpa Pig has built a fantastic little train called Gertrude, and when they take a ride, they give all their friends a ride.
Peppa and George are visiting their big cousin Chloe and will get to meet Chloe's new baby brother Alexander for the first time.

Rainbow Puppy is filming a music video in Mexico City, and she needs us to join her! But when Tour Bus breaks down, how will we get there in time? We'll play Blue's Clues as we dance, learn new Spanish words, and explore Mexico City!
Paddington has to decide whether to support England or Peru before the football match, but he loves both countries. It's time for Aunt Lucy to go home, but there's still time for one last adventure.
Gargamel needs someone to watch over the Smurfs he's captured. Papa Smurf loses his memory and starts acting like a child.
Three baby ladybirds, Amber, Emerald and Keith have come to stay at Uncle Gaston's for the day. The baby ladybirds are exhausting! So Ben and Holly help Gaston to keep them entertained.
The bath tap at the Little Castle is dripping, so the elf plumber is called. It's a bigger job than first expected, but with King and Queen Marigolds coming round, there's not much time.
Peppa loves cycling downhill, but is not so keen on pedalling uphill, so she insists everyone have a downhill race.
Zoe Zebra delivers a very special letter for Peppa and George, an invitation to her birthday party.
Daddy Pig winds up the old cuckoo clock in Peppa and George's bedroom. When the clock strikes the hour, a wooden bird pops out, flapping its wings and singing 'Cuckoo'.
Peppa and George go ice skating, but they have never been before, and Peppa keeps falling over.
The grass has grown so long that Peppa and George's ball gets lost in it. It falls to Grandpa to save the day with Betsy, his motorised lawnmower.
When Peppa and George go to the dentist for a check-up, Dr Elephant says their teeth are nice and white, but George's toy dinosaur is in need of a tooth clean.
Madame Gazelle takes Peppa and her school friends on a school bus trip to the mountains. From the top of the mountains, there is a fantastic view, and Peppa and her friends have fun hearing echoes.
When a spell accidentally goes wrong, Ben and Holly grow to human size! Now they are able to play with Lucy and her friends and want to stay big forever.
Granny Thistle comes to visit and gives Daisy and Poppy a powerful magical wand. The children escape from the castle and go bananas.
Mr Elf is overworked so King Thistle sentences him to a holiday. He isn't too pleased, but Mrs Elf and Ben are overjoyed! Meanwhile, Nanny takes over the food deliveries.
Inspired by a sparkly banana, Gabby and her friends make the most of a rainy day in the dollhouse and craft songs and snacks.
Peppa and George are helping Granny and Grandpa Pig tidy their attic, but they have trouble deciding what to throw out because Granny and Grandpa want to keep everything.
Peppa and Suzy Sheep are best friends, but one day they have a quarrel over a game of cards and decide they are not best friends any more.

Peppa and George's toy basket is full, and their beds are covered in toys, so Mummy Pig decides it is time to order a new toy cupboard. The cupboard arrives in the post, but it needs to be assembled - and Mummy and Daddy Pig are not very good at DIY. Luckily help is at hand, as Mr Zebra the Postman loves assembling flat-pack furniture.
Peppa and her friends go on a camping trip with their teacher, Madame Gazelle. After pitching their tents and collecting sticks, they all sing a song around the campfire.
Peppa and her family borrow Grandpa Pig's boat and head out for a day on the river. All is going well until the boat gets stuck in some long reeds. Daddy Pig to the rescue.
When a power cut plunges their house into darkness, Peppa and George have fun looking for a torch and thinking of games to play in the dark.
Mr. Park has a Chickaletta topiary, but when Digi and Tal try to help, things get worse; Humdinger creates havoc with a moose and geyser as he tours Yellowbone Park in his rolling Hum-Ball.

The PAW Patrol searches for Julia, Julius, and a flamingo when they go missing from a dance contest; the PAW Patrol comes to the rescue when Mayor Goodway and her niece Julia get stuck on a runaway art installation.
Holly shrinks Lucy and her dog, Rex, so that they can play in the Little Kingdom.
Ben, Holly, and their friends go on a snail trek. Everything goes well until the snails start to head to Mr Elf's cabbages.
When Captain Squid leaves his treasure map in the Little Kingdom, Redbeard the Elf Pirate leads Ben, Holly and Nanny Plum on a treasure hunt.
Ben Elf and his parents are going on holiday in the elf truck but Gaston the Ladybird has swallowed the car keys.

Mummy and Daddy Pig let Peppa and George put their coats on over their pyjamas and go outside to look at the stars. With the help of a telescope, Daddy Pig teaches Peppa and George how to find the North Star.
It's Daddy Pig's birthday, but he has to go to work, so while he's away, Mummy Pig, Peppa and George prepare a special birthday surprise.
When Peppa goes for a sleepover at Zoe Zebra's house with Suzy Sheep, Rebecca Rabbit, Candy Cat and Emily Elephant, the girls are too excited to go to sleep.
Peppa and Luzie Locke find that adults have to work all the time. The children imitate the elders, in the shop and on the playground. They realise that playing can be really hard work.
Peppa and her family spot a rainbow when they go for a drive.
Pedro gets a cough at playschool and the other children soon catch it. Doctor Brownbear is called and gives them horrible medicine, but who will look after him when he is ill?
Daddy Pig has a book from the library that he has kept for too long. The family go to the library to return it and find more books to read.
Peppa and George take a bin of vegetable peelings to Grandpa Pig's compost heap. Worms inside the bin turn the peelings into compost, which Granny and Grandpa use to help their plants grow.

Paddington makes a new caterpillar friend, and he and Judy learn that not all changes are negative ones. To keep the floor clean, Mr Brown declares that the floor is now lava. The Brown family then play a fun game to keep things tidy.
When Mayor Humdinger and his mother help Mayor Goodway look for a rare tulip, Humdinger gets them all in trouble; the pups must save Daring Danny X when a mechanical shark stunt goes awry.
Mayor Humdinger looks forward to a special day with his mother, but the Humsquatch accidentally gets in their way. The pups embark on a mission to find the museum's stolen exhibit.

Richard Rabbit comes to play with George, while Suzy Sheep plays with Peppa. The boys don't want to play the same games as the girls, but they all agree that they like jumping up and down in muddy puddles.
Daddy Pig hangs his clean football shirt out to dry, but Peppa, George and Mummy splash it with mud. They put it in the wash, but Peppa puts her red dress in too, which turns Daddy's shirt pink.
Peppa and George go on a boat trip with Grandpa Pig, but they must send Polly Parrot for help when their boat runs aground. Polly fetches Granny Pig and Grandad Dog to rescue them.
Delphine the donkey comes to stay. Peppa takes Delphine to playgroup, where they teach her the 'Bing Bong Song'.
When Mummy Pig helps out at Miss Rabbit's fire station, she is called upon to douse the flames at Daddy Pig's out-of-control barbecue.
Granny and Grandpa Pig come for a dinner party with Mummy and Daddy Pig. Peppa and George are too tired to go to bed until they are told a story.
Peppa brings home a teddy from playgroup to look after, but she is worried that he will not have a very exciting time.
It is Danny Dog's birthday, and with the help of Grandad Dog and Grandpa Pig the children take part in a pirate treasure hunt.
When Crusher and Pickle are trapped at the top of a tall, rickety tower, Blaze, Stripes and Starla transform into awesome construction vehicles to build a way down.
Heading down the stripey brick road on a quest to get home; meeting Rainbow Puppy the Kind Witch, Tinbox, and even the Wizard of Skidoo himself, Steve!
Peppa wins her first star for making a wonderful drawing of her house. Dad realises that he has never won a single star and is determined to solve the problem.
On a beautiful sunny day, Grandpa takes Peppa and George to spend the day sailing. After an accident, the boat ends up sinking, and now they need rescuing with a hovercraft.

The Detective introduces his new friend, the superhero Super Potato, who teaches children the importance of eating fruit and vegetables every day, and later helps the Detective out of a complicated situation.
Tiddles gets stuck in a tree and needs to be rescued. When the turtle falls on Pedro's nose, he needs to go to the doctors to make sure everything is OK.
Peppa and her family visit a museum, and Peppa likes the Kings and Queens room, whereas George's favourite is the dinosaur room.
The doctor teaches children what to do if there is ever an accident. A patient soon appears, and they put into practise the new techniques they have learned.
Peppa and family take a trip to the market to buy some apples, cheese and fish. However, they get more than they were expecting when they stop by Mr Fox's stall as he is selling some special items.

It's Richard Rabbit's birthday party and George is invited. That can only mean one thing, soft play. George and friends have great fun, swinging, bouncing and climbing, but it isn't quite as much fun for the grown-ups.

It's Halloween, but will a curse on the theatre stop the community putting on their show? Taylor the lifeguard arrives in Windsor Gardens, and just in time to save the Mooncake festival with Paddington.

Taylor reveals it's his birthday, but how can his friends make it special when they had no idea? It's Burn's Night and Mrs Bird teaches Paddington about a rare creature called a Wild Haggis, but will it visit them?

1. Geschichte: SpongeBob muss es mit den härtesten Jungs der Unterwasserstadt, den Sharks aufnehmen. 2. Geschichte: Plankton hat einen fiesen Plan: Um an die Geheimformel zu kommen, klont er SpongeBob! Doch das Original kommt ihm in die Quere.
Tim und Tommy nehmen sich vor, zusammen einen möglichst großen Mondkürbis heranzuzüchten.
Tim und Tommy helfen in der Eiszeit-Stube aus und stellen sich neuen Aufgaben im Alltag.
Oma schenkt Tim einen selbstgemachten Hut, doch der erweist sich immer wieder als störend.

Dora will den Flizadu finden, der in dem Vogel-Fotoalbum von Doras Abuela fehlt. Sie will ein Bild für Abuela von ihm machen. Dora und Boots wollen dem Papageienbaby Lorito helfen, denn er sucht seine Mutter, doch er macht Boots immer nach.

Lincoln kauft sich zum Planschen einen kleinen Pool. Doch seine schöne Vorstellung vom entspannten Baden wird von seinen Schwestern gestört. Lincoln will Baby Lily für seine Hobbys begeistern. Aber er ist nicht der Einzige, der um ihre Gunst buhlt.

Lincoln darf endlich mal einen Freund zum Übernachten mitbringen. Doch der gemeinsame Abend verläuft anders, als es sich Lincoln vorgestellt hat. Lincoln belauscht ein Gespräch seiner Eltern. Er glaubt zu hören, dass sie die Kinder loswerden wollen.

Lincoln hat ein Mädchenfahrrad geerbt. Natürlich schämt er sich für das Rad, was ihn jedoch auf eine Idee bringt - eine fatale Idee. Lincoln wird beschuldigt, die Toilette verstopft zu haben - hat er aber nicht. Nun sucht er den wahren Schuldigen.

Will und Min helfen Jack bei der Suche nach einer guten Geschichte. Lily verschüttet Bubbletea in Jacks Koffer und will ihre Spuren verwischen. Lily zeigt Jack, wie man einen perfekten Sommertag in Canyon Valley verbringt.

Die Familie will in einem Asia-Laden einen seltenen Keks ergattern. Jack ist glücklich, denn nun fühlt er sich als Teil der Familie. Nach einer schlechten Bewertung des Tierpflegesalons will Lily unbedingt den Schuldigen finden.

Damit Schere einen Gratis-Kuchen im Café bekommt, lügt er über den Geburtstag von Stein. Daraufhin muss das Trio vor der Geburtstagspolizei fliehen. Papier lügt, um seine Nachbarin Bleistift zu beeindrucken, was Folgen hat.

Das Trio will einen Pogo-Stick beschaffen, um unbedingt zu der Party von den Ratten-Bros zu gehen. Stein bewirbt sich um einen Job bei der "Fiese-Roboter-Company". Papier und Schere prüfen deshalb, ob das Unternehmen die Wahrheit sagt.

1. Geschichte: Um hinter SpongeBob herzukommen, wachsen Gary Beine. Aber dadurch sieht SpongeBob im Vergleich zu ihm langsam aus. Kann er seine Schnecke einholen? 2. Geschichte: Plankton will die Welt beherrschen und schrumpft sich selbst. Um das zu üben, ernennt er sich in SpongeBobs Aquarium zum König. Geht das gut?

1. Geschichte: Planktons Abfall-Deponie ist zu voll. Durch einen Hinterhalt versteckt SpongeBob für ihn den Abfall überall in der Stadt. 2. Geschichte: SpongeBob schließt Freundschaft mit einer kleinen Gewitterwolke. Weil ein verrückter Meteorologe hinter ihr her ist, muss SpongeBob sie beschützen. Schafft er das?

Plankton will über Thaddäus an die geheime Formel kommen, was allerdings völlig nach hinten losgeht. Thaddäus will derweil mal wieder als Künstler durchstarten, macht aber stattdessen Patrick zum Star der Kunstwelt.

Überraschenderweise gewinnt Mr. Krabs eine Reise auf einem Kreuzfahrtschiff. Um sich vor Ort entspannen zu können und um sich um nichts kümmern zu müssen, nimmt er SpongeBob mit. Außerdem nimmt er die Geheimformel mit, damit er beruhigt sein kann.

Ronnie Anne ist nervös, weil sie nach einem schweren Sturz wieder mit dem Skateboardfahren beginnen will. Außerdem ist ein mächtiges Artefakt auf dem Weg zum Museum, und das bringt die gesamte Familie Casagrande in Aufruhr.

Mr. Chang muss beweisen, dass er so flink wie ein Roboter arbeiten kann, um seinen Job nicht zu verlieren. Adelaide will unbedingt die Stadtkatzen in ein besseres Licht setzen, damit diese eine bessere Chance haben, adoptiert zu werden.

1. Geschichte: Dad sorgt sich, dass Lola seine Wortwitze falsch verstanden haben könnte und nun denkt er habe Lieblingskinder. Wie kann er diesen Gedanken zerstreuen? 2. Geschichte: Lynn versucht ihre Freundin Margo in deren Lieblingssport Fußball zu unterstützen.

1. Geschichte: Lucy will den Schreibclub der Schule verlassen, weil sie Huggins Leitung nicht länger erträgt. Um das zu verhindern, übernimmt Mom die Leitung des Clubs. Ob sich die Situation für Lucy damit verbessert? 2. Geschichte: Luna und Sam müssen bei einer Schnitzeljagd durch Royal Woods Teamgeist beweisen.

1. Geschichte: Luan will ihren Schwarm Benny näher kommen und bewirbt sich um eine Rolle im Schultheaterstück. 2. Geschichte: Clyde findet mit seinem Schulkameraden Zach ein gemeinsames Interesse an Antiquitäten. Schnell fühlt sich Lincoln von den beiden ausgeschlossen.

Damit Plankton die Geheimformel von Mr. Krabs stehlen kann, stellt er einen Praktikanten ein, der viel über ihn weiß. Patrick hat ein Problem: Er verliert die Kontrolle, wenn er eine Glocke hört. Seine Freunde versuchen ihm auf ihre Art zu helfen.

SpongeBob und Thaddäus sollen Blubberbernd zum Zahlen seiner Rechnungen überzeugen. Mr. Krabs möchte Mrs. Puff für sich gewinnen und beauftragt SpongeBob und Thaddäus ihm zu helfen. Diese sollen ihm etwas kochen, doch sie können sich nicht einigen.
Weil Patrick in der Handschuhwelt einen Roboter beschädigt, kommen er und SpongeBob ins Gefängnis. Es kommt zu einer chaotischen Flucht.
Das Trio macht sich gemeinsam auf den Weg, um sieben Limetten von Pipers Schwester zu bekommen.
SpongeBob und Thaddäus werden als Live-Act erfolgreich. // Cecil wird nach einem Unterwäsche-Unfall selbst Verkäufer.

Pinky heckt einen aufwendigen Plan aus, um ein versehentlich mitgenommenes Büchereibuch zurückzubringen. Als Pinky einem Football-Team beitritt, macht ihn sein Ehrgeiz bei Mitspielern und Fans unbeliebt.

Die Louds reisen gemeinsam nach Neapel, denn sie wollen die beste Pizza der Welt probieren. Gebacken wird diese aber von einer geheimniskrämerischen Köchin. Lori und Leni helfen Lynn mit einem Jungen in den Schweizer Alpen zu sprechen.

Als der Bus der Louds eine Reifenpanne hat, dürfen sie im mysteriösen Schloss eines unheimlichen Paares übernachten. Bei einer Besichtigung des Parthenons setzt Lincoln einen Kriegerhelm auf, der ihn ins antike Griechenland befördert.

Lincoln und seine Freunde versuchen, sich mit Kara, der Neuen, anzufreunden, als sie erfahren, dass sie an ein legendäres, verschollenes Comic-Heft kommt. Miguel bittet Leni um Hilfe, um seine eigene Parfum-Marke bei Reininger herauszubringen.

Squidwards scherzhafter Vater besucht ihn und bringt alle möglichen ulkigen Scherzartikel mit, die seinen Sohn ärgern. Außerdem versucht Plankton, die Geheimformel zu probieren, indem er sich an SpongeBobs Zunge festklebt.

Perch Perkins kämpft darum, seinen Job zu behalten, nachdem er entlassen und durch einen Roboter-Moderator ersetzt wurde. SpongeBob, Patrick und Squidward geraten in Schwierigkeiten, als sie freiwillige Feuerwehrleute werden.
Weil Thaddäus' Porträt von SpongeBob in der Kunstwelt Wellen schlägt, muss er mehr produzieren.

Perla verspricht ihren Freunden Krabbenburger, doch die Cafeteria verbietet es. Als SpongeBob und Mr. Krabs heimlich dort welche braten, kommt es nach Lenores Entdeckung zu einer Essensschlacht. Doch der Geschmack überzeugt die Köchin am Ende.

Wir werfen einen Blick auf zwei Abenteuer von SpongeBob. Zuerst verwandelt ihn ein Biss von KritzelBob in einen Wer-Kritzel. Danach sorgt er im Gorillakostüm für großes Aufsehen, weil ihn alle für einen echten Gorilla halten.

Mrs. Puff kann SpongeBob nicht mehr ertragen und schickt ihn in eine Fahrschule in einem anderen Land. In der Zwischenzeit sorgt Slappy als neuer, makaberer Kellner in der Krossen Krabbe für großes Chaos unter den Gästen.
Als Patricks Zeit Kleiderschrank den Geist aufgibt, wird SpongeBobs Vergangenheit von zeitreisenden Eindringlingen umgeschrieben.

When Pencil comes over to watch a horror movie, Paper worries he'll be too scared to handle it. There's a light wind, and Paper is far from home. Rock and Scissors try to save him before he blows away forever.

The Mortician's Club must stop the elementary school faculty from eating goblin-transforming cupcakes. While interning for Mariella Moss, Leni faces a fashion dilemma when her boyfriend protests Mariella's new accessory launch.
With nappies piling up in the Templetons' basement, Boss Baby hatches a plan to break into Baby Corp, kick out his enemies and take his business back.
The Star family rent three movies from a haunted video store. From kids to romance to a story about ageing backwards, there's a movie to terrify every member of the family.
While at Kamp Koral for a reunion, SpongeBob and the gang are stalked by a mysterious figure lurking in the shadows as campers start disappearing one by one!
A silver ant needs help getting back home after being swept up by a sandstorm; Sam and Kit head to the swamp to investigate a dinosaur sighting.

Sir Steel is determined for Platinum City to secure a musical award, but a disruptive music ray causes problems. Baron Bite takes control of Dinobot using a Control Collar and amasses an army of snow.
Everyone's in the Cat-O-Ween spirit; Gabby and Pandy make cat-o-lanterns with Baby Box, search for treats with MerCat, and make banana ghosts with Cakey.
On Halloween, Smurfette gives Wimpy a magic pumpkin to help him scare the other Smurfs. When Azrael gets injured in the forest, Wild brings the cat to the Smurfs' village to heal.
SpongeBob builds a pool in his backyard and Squidward tries to resist taking a dip; Mr. Krabs must reckon with the Goobfather after he adds patty whips to the menu.
Plankton's family open their own restaurant directly next to the Chum Bucket; SpongeBob suddenly finds everything funny, much to everyone's annoyance.
Patrick hosts an award ceremony; Captain Doug Quasar meets Pat-Tron's robot family.
Bunny tries to punish Patrick for chocolate-favoured crimes. The Lawnies vote for what Patrick does next in a 'Choose Your Own Adventure' special.

In an attempt to get out of the dentist, Lily insists on a summer celebration of the fall holiday Chuseok. When Will accidentally befriends an annoying man, his sorry attempts at a break-up make things painfully awkward for the whole family.
To save Captain Dread's crew and recapture the Shard, Sonic will have to do what he does best: act fast. Luckily he has help from an unexpected ally.
Boss Baby throws a cupcake party to combat low company morale, then sends a manager to help Tim handle some family business.
A giant goo bubble emerges from Goo Lagoon and threatens all of Bikini Bottom, except for Plankton, who plans to use the bubble for his own evil ends.
SpongeBob and Patrick go to see the latest horror film, only to be seemingly stalked by the villain. SpongeBob holds a seance at the Krusty Krab to learn the recipe for a long-lost sandwich.

Reality will cease to exist unless a selfless hero makes the ultimate sacrifice; however, it may not be enough to reverse the damage Nine caused to the universe.
SpongeBob and Patrick have a spirited Halloween night at the Chum Bucket. Gary's favourite ball falls into monster-filled trench.
When Lily and Jack must unexpectedly sacrifice their own summer plans, it kicks off a new, chaotic normal, starting with a runaway trailer that each insists on saving their own way.
When a meteor unleashes a virus that turns zoo animals into zombies, a mountain lion and a wolf lead a team of survivors to save the day.
The Sibunas find the real Miss Denby, who has some revelations for them. Jerome sets his sights on Willow and Joy boosts her confidence with a brand-new look.
The Sibunas uncover the details of the secret ceremony in a very special place. They rush to rescue Harriet Denby, but discover she's gone. Jerome's love life is in a tangle.
Henry and Ray try to help Piper carry out a 'meet cute' with a new boy she likes from school.
Dr. Minyak challenges Captain Man to the Swellview Spelling Bee; Charlotte competes to be the winner for the fourth year in a row.
To establish The Lip Balms as Mapleview's top squad, Lydia volunteers her clique to be front and centre of the upcoming school assembly, despite their protests.
Taylor finds a photo of Uncle Charlie from 1953 and later an old watch that activates mysteriously.
The gang come across an old perfume bottle amidst some buried treasure, which causes Taylor and Lila to age. While they try to reverse the perfume's effects, the South Section steal the bottle.

The kids find the stolen puzzle box and try to hide it from the police. Erik returns home but is acting suspicious. Daniel finds a clue in the museum footage and after tough goodbyes, Max leaves for Spain.
The Hunters meet a young girl named Evie, and her necklace has the same crown symbol they discovered in the cryptex. Erik reveals that he has a special connection to Evie.

Plankton creates a clone of himself and Mr Krabs, but neither restaurant is safe from the newcomer. Squidward gleefully switches jobs with a bus driver for an easy ride until SpongeBob and Patrick climb aboard.
SpongeBob volunteers to babysit, then SpongeBob and Patrick volunteer as guards at the museum, while Squidward attempts to hang his painting unnoticed.

Alvin and Brittany learn parenting is not easy when they have to care for a robot baby for a school assignment. When Alvin's football team struggles, the coach makes the team learn ballet to help with their conditioning.
The Chipmunks decide to find Dave a new girlfriend. The Chipmunks accidentally ruin Dave's new song for a music festival.

After Brittany and the girls release a video that goes viral, Alvin, Simon, and Theodore try to top it. Simon falls ill and asks Alvin and Theodore not to go see a new movie without him, but Alvin just cannot resist.

When Dave tells Simon to get rid of some stuff, a few of his more dangerous experiments end up in the wrong hands. Dave and the boys rent a cabin in the woods for a little rest and relaxation, only to find out it may be haunted.

When the girls at school develop a crush on the fire marshal, Alvin decides to be a hero with disastrous results; after causing an accident at a historic castle, Cheesy and Alvin work as reenactors to pay for the damage.
Alvin's too short to ride a new amusement park ride; while on a ski trip, Alvin convinces Theodore there's a Yeti nearby.

Theodore gives Dave an ugly handmade vest for his birthday and insists he wear it to an upcoming business meeting. When Theodore finds a winning lottery ticket, everyone has their own ideas on how the money should be spent.
Dave has a writer's block. Alvin puts a curse on Theodore.

Alvin sneaks into Simon's lab to look at his latest invention, only to accidentally clone himself. With two Alvins, there's double the trouble. Alvin tells a small lie that quickly turns into a huge disaster, dragging everyone into his tangled web.

Alvin and Brittany get stuck alone at the school with a ghost they think roams the halls. Alvin passes off a rock he found on the ground as a meteor for a science project and gets some unwanted attention.
Alvin believes his mojo was in a cap he regrets giving to a fan. During a visit to the zoo, Alvin is mistaken for a Tasmanian devil.
Jeanette seeks Alvin's advice when she wants to give a toast to Brittany at her upcoming party. Alvin decides to borrow Brittany's babysitting job.

When Alvin notices Brittany being nice to him, he's sure an alien has taken over her body. In order to earn a job on the school newspaper, Alvin helps Simon uncover the biggest story the school's ever seen.

When the kids tease Kevin about his lame parties, Alvin decides to host the coolest paintball party at his house, for Kevin. When Bocarter boasts about his cool computer, the boys feel pressure to keep up with their nemesis and end up causing a disaster.
Alvin borrows Simon's invisibility suit, but gets trapped when the zip gets stuck. After Theodore makes a wish, the Chipmunks try to learn what it was so they can make it come true.

The chipmunks help an owner fix up his run-down summer camp and his broken relationship with his brother. Alvin believes that Theodore cursed him so that he can never lie again and cannot help himself from blabbing the truth.

When Alvin is accused of revealing spoilers for everyone's favourite TV show, he agrees not to speak for 24 hours. When Alvin and Simon think Theodore's pet goldfish has died, they go all out to replace it before he notices.

When pirates show up at the house, the boys do all they can to protect a treasure chest that arrived for Dave. The Chipmunks and Chipettes compete to set a world record in hopes of winning a new virtual reality game.

Alvin's attempts to earn money as an Internet influencer almost puts a local toy store out of business; the Chipmunks accidentally ruin Dave's new pavilion, and they allow Miss Miller to take the fall.

The boys disobey Dave's orders to not play a dangerous game, then have to hide their injuries when they get hurt. The school newspaper has a sudden increase in sales when a gossip column appears poking fun at other students.
Alvin helps the mathletes stand up to the school bullies, but in the process they become bullies themselves; Alvin befriends a new student, but Theodore learns something surprising about him.
Alvin gets a lesson in parenting after he kidnaps Simon's robot; when Dave takes away Alvin's phone, the boredom Alvin experiences is enough to drive him crazy.
Alvin believes a neighbour is responsible for a recent diamond heist. Alvin tries to get out of the annual family day picnic with Dave to go to a big soccer game.

Theodore tries to overcome his fear of sleepovers by spending the night at Kevin's house without Alvin or Simon. Plus, when Alvin sees every celebrity with their own personal bodyguard, he decides to train Theodore for the job.

When the boys get stuck with Miss Miller as a babysitter, they each take a crack at finding a replacement. Alvin volunteers to caddy a charity golf tournament and surprisingly gets paired up with Miss Smith.
Simon is alarmed to discover that he has been tagging private property in his sleep. Alvin's luck goes from bad to worse after Theodore finds a four-leaf clover and everything starts going his way.
While cleaning out their treehouse, the girls reminisce about how they saved the tree from being cut down; Alvin and Theodore think that Simon is going away to boarding school.

The Chipmunks have 48 hours to help Jeanette make a student film, but they all have a different movie in mind; The Chipmunks follow Dave and fear that he's fallen in love with a woman who wants to turn him into a wax statue!

When Theodore discovers Alvin and Simon have a secret club, he promises not to tell anyone if they let him join. Dave promises to take Alvin to a water park if he gets a good grade on his test, but then a crow steals it.
The boy's imaginations run wild when Dave disappears; when they finally find him, they're convinced he's a zombie; Alvin tries to convince Dave that he's being hunted by a flying beast.
After a fight with Brittany, Eleanor decides to move in with Alvin and his brothers. Theodore posts a video of himself rapping on the Internet and it becomes a big hit.

Everyone thinks Simon has lost his mind after he fails a school test and moves into a tree for some alone time. Alvin worries about his bad report card and does everything he can to intercept the mail before Dave sees it.
Miss Croner attempts to help Theodore discover his true calling in life. Jeanette is suddenly the clumsiest person on the planet.
After getting detention again, Alvin's convinced Dave will drive him to the desert and abandon him there; Alvin and Theodore play a seemingly innocent game, which leads to unexpected consequences.
Team 'That's TV' present a round-up of the local news for Greater Belfast, Northern Ireland.
James' father arrives at the manor, but he is in trouble with the police and is trying to flee the country with help from his son's co-workers.
The Boswell boys are in love, and Oswald is confused by Aveline's overnight transformation into a career woman.

Harold is fed up with scraping a living and with Albert's constant criticism of his ability to do the rounds. He decides to follow a different vocation and takes a correspondence course in TV repairing.

In the early 1960s, Cecil Parkin becomes station master at Hatley. He finds May, an old flame, now married to Jack the porter. Cecil learns of Beeching's plans to close rural stations like Hatley for being uneconomical.
Rigsby is given some advice from Alan and Philip, as well as some tablets to calm his nerves in his amorous pursuit of Miss Jones.
A girl tells Jo and Chrissy that she is pregnant by Robin after sleeping with her. When they confront him, he agrees to do the decent thing and to stand by his girlfriend, Linda.
When Gary and Phoebe discover the lease on the Royal Oak has run out and Reg is retiring, they realise it is time to make plans for the future.
Jack's loyalties are tested when he gets an invitation from an old friend.
Arthur discovers that he may be next in line to inherit a fortune, but can he trace back the Daley ancestry?
News of Uncle Jacob's death comes with a mixture of regret and relief for the Colliers, and the funeral gives Bob an insight into his own future.

Robin is due to play for the college in a football game but ends up in bed with a heavy cold, which he has caught from George Roper. The girls do their best to find ways to get him up and about in time for the game.
Dorien's book group come together to discuss Dostoevsky's 'Crime and Punishment' - which turns out to be surprisingly appropriate when Tracey warns Garth not to lead his younger brother astray.
DS Morley offers Arthur a cheap police transport coach. Arthur is uneasy about the deal until he has a Euro vision - Daley Tours - Arthur and Ray head to Heathrow for a trial run.
When The Solana's meat supplier lets Joyce down, she asks Lesley to help her out - who in turn enlists Mateo.

In the final episode of the tenth series, it's a big day for Mimi Maguire - it's her first wedding anniversary to Billy, and they're going to renew their vows. Determined to make a fresh start, Mimi sets about throwing away memories of her past life with Paddy, but she alienates a furious Ruby with her comments. An emergency meeting is held about Patty's deteriorating health and Frank takes on the task of letting her know.
Hercules the horse is sick and must be taken to the vet and the Steptoes' business is under threat. Fellow totters rally around and Albert and Harold hatch a plan to help out and make a profit.
Phoebe is due to give birth, but her cantankerous midwife is a little the worse for wear having had one too many drinks.
Thieves jeopardise Arthur's attempt to crack the wine business.

Songs you really like but are a bit too embarrassed to admit. Don't worry, we're all in the same boat here & Pat urges you to try to have a little less shame in your musical game!
Feelgood hits from just 1 decade - the 1970s! Platform boots and flares at the ready?

30 of the biggest, timeless anthems! Featuring legendary acts like Aerosmith, Kiss, and Queen, through to Razorlight, Fall Out Boy and Evanescence.

Charlotte kann nicht fassen, dass Julius tot ist. Doris wiederum wird von ihrem schlechten Gewissen gequält und heuchelt Mitleid. Natascha springt über ihren Schatten und entschuldigt sich bei Konstantin für den Streit.

Charlotte versucht, tapfer zu sein. Marlene fällt Julius' Manuskript für seinen zweiten Roman in die Hände. Franziska muss der amerikanischen Klinik, in der ihr Sohn Tim behandelt wird, einen Vorschuss für dessen Untersuchungen zahlen.
Natascha überrascht Konstantin mit dem Vorschlag, ein Kind zu adoptieren. Doris verteidigt sich aufgewühlt vor Charlotte, der ihr Ausraster vor den Trauergästen sehr peinlich ist.

Klara Degen feiert zusammen mit Sylvia, Lena und ihren Kollegen das alljährliche Vereinsfest des Polizeisportvereins. Eine Band spielt auf. Frontmann Jens Riebel war einst Klaras große Jugendliebe. Noch immer scheint es zwischen den beiden zu knistern. Hauptkommissar Paul Kleinert registriert die gegenseitigen Blicke der beiden mit gemischten Gefühlen. Da besteigt Evelyn Brenner, eine ehemalige Backgroundsängerin und Exfreundin von Jens, die Bühne und verpasst ihm eine Ohrfeige.

Eine Teilnehmerin der bevorstehenden Wahl zur Miss Harz wird während der Generalprobe tot in ihrer Garderobe aufgefunden. Ausgerechnet Klara Degens Schwester Sylvia hat die Leiche entdeckt und die Polizei alarmiert. Deshalb nimmt Hauptkommissar Kleinert, der zusammen mit Kollege Ollenhauer zum Tatort eilt, ausnahmsweise auch Klara mit, damit sie sich um die geschockte Sylvia kümmern kann. Marie Gäbler, Favoritin der Miss-Wahl, wurde vermutlich vergiftet.

Udo würde am liebsten mit Marlies ein neues Leben anfangen. Doch für ihn kommt eine Trennung von Inge nicht infrage. Daher ist Udo auch entsetzt, als sein heimliches Treffen mit Marlies für Inge den Ausschlag gibt: Sie will, dass er auszieht. Jana lässt sich von Maurice überreden, bei der Homestory über ihn an seiner Seite zu stehen. Als sie jedoch miterlebt, wie Maurice in Gegenwart der Presse zum eitlen Selbstdarsteller mutiert, ist sie mehr als befremdet.

Theo versucht krampfhaft, vor Lutz, Torben und Carla seinen Stress mit dem Handydealer zu verbergen. Denn der erpresst Theo zu einer weiteren Zusammenarbeit und unterstreicht seine Drohung mit einem ersten Anschlag. Jana und Maurice geraten in eine ernsthafte Auseinandersetzung, weil Jana die Zusage zur Fortsetzung der Homestory zurückzieht. Wegen des Streits unterläuft Maurice während einer OP ein Missgeschick.

Der introvertierte Wieland Hagen und der extrovertierte, lebenslustige Harald Meerholm sind Freunde seit ihrer Kindheit. Harald hat in der Werbebranche gearbeitet, ist aber überall angeeckt, weil er zu unzuverlässig war. Wieland, Besitzer eines Eiswagens, gewährt Harald Gnadenbrot als Eisverkäufer. Doch zu Wielands Leidwesen spielt sich Harald im Eiswagen als Werbegenie auf und legt auf Zuverlässigkeit nicht den geringsten Wert.

Elena Eichhorn hat Philipp Brentano nach Arzus Rausschmiss bei sich aufgenommen. Als sie ihren Freund Valentin auf das Thema Zusammenziehen anspricht, benutzt er Philipps Notlage als Vorwand, das Ganze zu vertagen. Elena spürt allerdings, dass Valentins Zurückhaltung mit seiner Tochter Jenny zusammenhängt. Wenig später in der Klinik kippt Dr. Eichhorn vor einer Operation mit Dr. Kaminski um. Der Verdacht auf eine Malaria Tropica bestätigt sich. Sie hat sich in Ghana infiziert.

Mascha Hillinger und Karin Berger übernehmen die Leitung im Hotel Heidelberg. Während die international erfahrene Hotelmanagerin Karin auf maximale Effizienz setzt, will Mascha die gutbürgerliche Hotelküche komplett auf vegan umstellen.

Als Hauptkommissar Paul Kleinert zufällig seiner Sekretärin Klara Degen vor einem Kino begegnet und sich schon auf einen gemeinsamen Abend freut, wird er zum Fundort einer Frauenleiche gerufen. Am Fuße eines Steilhangs liegt Gaby König, nur mit Wanderschuhen bekleidet. Für Kleinert sieht es nach einem Unfall aus. Vermutlich ist sie vom bei FKK-Anhängern beliebten Naturistenstieg abgekommen und gestürzt.

Hauptkommissar Paul Kleinert steckt in Gewissensnöten. Seiner Mutter, die in Magdeburg lebt, wurde die Handtasche geraubt und nun fordert sie energisch, er müsse die Ermittlungen aufnehmen. Kleinert schickt Wolter zum Einsatz nach Magdeburg.

Jana gerät mit Merle aneinander, weil sie treu zu dem unter seinem OP-Fehler leidenden Maurice steht, während Merle ihn als kaltschnäuzig und arrogant hinstellt. Als Jana ihrer Freundin wütend die Weitergabe von OP-Infos an die Presse unterstellt, reagiert Merle tief verletzt und stellt ihre Freundschaft infrage. Der unbekannte Handydealer droht Theo mit dem Abbrennen der Würstchenbude, sollte er nicht weitere gestohlene Handys für ihn verkaufen.

Torben weiß, dass er für seine drei Söhne kein besonders guter Vater war, und will zukünftig mehr Zeit mit ihnen verbringen. Beflügelt schlägt er Anne vor, sich um Max zu kümmern, wenn sie für acht Wochen beruflich ins Ausland geht. Anne lehnt ab - ihr Lebensgefährte ist Max mehr Vater als Torben. Der reagiert schwer getroffen. Thomas unterstellt Merle, dass sie den prähistorischen Knochen absichtlich auf dem Flughafengelände ausgelegt hat.

Fiona will André erpressen, die Hochzeit abzusagen, entschließt sich dann aber, den Fürstenhof zu verlassen. Unterwegs begegnet sie Elisabeth und gesteht ihr den Mord. André verkündet, dass er Charlotte heiratet. Gregor bleibt tapfer.

Fiona kann Elisabeth aus dem Wagen ziehen, bevor sie selbst auf der Straße zusammenbricht. Zufälligerweise kommen Felix und Gregor am Unfallort vorbei und finden die verunglückten Frauen. Elisabeth erzählt ihnen, dass Fiona den Mord gestanden hat.

Ironische Beiträge und Reportagen beleuchten die Skurrilitäten der politischen Woche. Aber auch andere gesellschaftlich relevante und aktuelle Themen werden auf ihr Humorpotenzial hin überprüft und gegebenenfalls gewürdigt.

Nach Henrys VIII. Tod werden seine Kinder Mary, Elizabeth und Edward zu Figuren in einem gefährlichen Spiel. Sie alle befinden sich im Kampf am englischen Hof um die Herrschaft über das neue England, in dem sie sich nun befinden.

Weihnachten bei Hofe: Ein Maskenspiel entzweit den Protestanten Edward und die Katholikin Mary. Elizabeth steht zwischen ihnen, als Mary verlangt, zu ihr zu ziehen. Lord Protector Somerset versucht, den Frieden zwischen den Geschwistern zu bewahren.

Der Plan von Lord Protektor, Frieden zwischen den Geschwistern zu stiften, veranlasst Catherine und Thomas dazu, ihren eigenen Plan zu beschleunigen. Die beiden beschließen, Elizabeths 15. Geburtstag als Vorwand zu nutzen.

Nachdem Elizabeth aus Catherine und Thomas' Haus fortgeschickt wurde, lebt sie unter Fremden im Haus von Kats Schwager Antony Denny. Aus Angst, jemand könnte erfahren, was in Chelsea passiert ist. Catherine und Thomas bilden eine Front gegen den Hof.
Geprägt von dem Erlebten ist Elizabeth entschlossen, nicht in dieselben Fallen zu treten, in die sie zuvor in Chelsea geraten war. Doch bald steht ihr eine neue Prüfung bevor.

Thomas' Taten belasten Elizabeth. Sie steht unter Hausarrest und muss sich beim Verhör durch Lord Dudley rehabilitieren. Lord Somerset muss sich nach den Taten seines Bruders dem wütenden Kronrat und dem erschütterten König stellen.

Im Fokus der Reportagen stehen Themen aus Wirtschaft, Umwelt, Gesundheit, Kultur oder Familie.

Verschiedene Themen der deutschen und internationalen Zeit- und Kulturgeschichte werden nachgezeichnet. Mit Expertengesprächen und szenischen Nacherzählungen werden dabei Vorkommnisse aus jüngerer und älterer Geschichte neu zum Leben erweckt.

Wasser ist nicht nur zum Trinken da: Zahlreiche Tierarten Asiens tummeln sich auf Nahrungssuche und zur Abkühlung in Seen und Flüssen oder lauern an den Rändern der Gewässer auf Beute. Schmelzwasser und Monsunregen sind gleichermaßen wichtig.

Asiens Gebirge wie der Himalaya oder der Karakorum haben eine einzigartige Tierwelt hervorgebracht, die perfekt an die extremen Lebensbedingungen in großer Höhe angepasst ist. Die asiatischen Gebirge zählen zu den extremsten Lebensräumen der Erde.

Isolierte Lebensräume, wie die Inseln von Sri Lanka, Indonesien und Japan, sind ein Experimentierkasten der Evolution: Abgetrennt von den Hauptpopulationen entstanden faszinierende Tierarten wie Komodowarane, Sumpfkrokodile und Nasenaffen.

Dieses Mal geht es in die Regenwälder Indonesiens, die für ihre Biodiversität bekannt sind. Doch auch hier sind Hüter der Natur aktiv, um sich für den Naturschutz einzusetzen, um etwa Gibbons zu retten oder Rochen vor dem Kochtopf zu bewahren.

Um dem brutalen Raubbau an der Landschaft und dem schlimmen Säugetiersterben in Australien entgegenzuwirken, haben sich Menschen als „Hüter der Natur" dem aktiven Naturschutz verschrieben. Sie sprechen von Geschichten voller Hoffnung und Tatkraft.

In der Sendung stellt sich eine Persönlichkeit mit interessanter Vita aus Gesellschaft, Kultur, Wirtschaft oder Politik in einem intensiven Gespräch über Hintergründe, Lebensentwürfe und Erfahrungen den Fragen der Moderatoren.

Im Frühjahr 1940 ist plötzlich eine ganze britische Armee in Dünkirchen von der Wehrmacht umzingelt. Mit einem letzten Schlag könnten Hitlers Truppen das nahezu wehrlose Expeditionskorps vernichten. Doch der Führer entscheidet anders.

Im September 1939 feuert ein deutsches U-Boot seinen ersten Torpedo ab. Damit beginnt die Atlantikschlacht. Admiral Karl Dönitz Ziel ist es, die alliierten Nachschublinien im Nordatlantik in einem brutalen Abnutzungskrieg nachhaltig zu zerstören.

The chief of police leads an investigation into what happened to his family friend and babysitter, who is reported missing when she doesn't come home from Christmas shopping, and is found beneath a snow bank weeks later.
