Rivals and other contemporaries discuss Ronnie and Reggie Kray, the prominently destructive gangsters who ran London's East End during the 1950s and '60s.

In the Roaring Twenties, Al Capone ruled an empire of crime in the Windy City: gambling, prostitution, bootlegging, bribery, narcotics trafficking, robbery, protection rackets, and murder. It seemed that law enforcement couldn't touch him, until one fatal night in 1929.
The death of Peppino Impastato in 1978 was dismissed by police as a random act. Because he was an anti-Mafia activist, questions have continuously been raised about the circumstances.
The chilling secrets of the Mafia's most notorious kingpins are exposed in this compelling series. Mobster Sam Giancana was associated with the Kennedys, Frank Sinatra and the CIA.
Lucky Luciano's crimes with the Mafia, including bribing high-ranking officials, got him 50 years in jail. However, when WWII broke out, the USA needed Luciano's help.
Lifting the lid on notorious mobsters. Joe Colombo loved fame and money and took on the FBI in the 70s, with his Italian-American Civil Rights League campaigning against harassment.
Ambitious John Gotti became the boss of the Gambino family by ordering the death of the group's former head and earned the nickname 'Teflon Don' after three acquittals.
Enforcer Tony "The Ant" Spilotro left dozens of bodies in his wake as he protected the Chicago Outfit's interests in Vegas casinos. Soon he became a target of the FBI and the Mob.
Tales of real-life crime told by the FBI. Vito Genovese dealt with disloyalty ruthlessly and rose through the Mafia ranks, but he was to cause his own downfall with a massive error.
Carmine Galante took the Mob into the world of heroin and even when locked up in jail, Galante still managed to control the streets and profit from his drug empire.
Ex-FBI agent Joe Pistone, who infiltrated the Mafia for six years as mobster 'Donnie Brasco', reveals how his undercover work led to over 100 convictions.
Financier Allen Dorfman used union pension funds to bankroll the Mafia and the FBI quickly realised they could bankrupt the Mob by pursuing Dorfman.
Joe Valachi was the first Mafia member to break the Mob's code of silence and turn public informer, revealing the term "Cosa Nostra" to the world.
Gambino family soldier Roy DeMeo and his crew were suspected of killing dozens of people and dismembering their bodies, but the FBI and other mobsters were soon on his trail.
Meyer Lansky was an associate of 'Lucky' Luciano and linked to criminal financial operations, but the FBI struggled to pin anything on him – or find his riches.
The final episode of this gripping series reveals what happened when the FBI pursued the five clans who ran organised crime in New York, as well as the fate of two brave informers.

Yellowstone National Park is home to one of nature's most sophisticated minds: the Common Raven. We follow a mated pair in the Lamar River Valley, revealing their astonishing intelligence and complex survival tactics in the harsh wilderness.
Siberian tigers, the largest of all cats, have experienced an almost total population crash during the past century with at least 97% gone.
An examination of the fierce snow leopard and how it became legendary for both its rarity and elusiveness.
An examination of pumas, which are distantly related to lions and much more closely related to cheetahs.
Observing the life cycle of the Ibex Buck, an iconic animal of the European Alpine peaks.

2,000 rivers and streams dig deep into the underground and transport their water into reservoirs or Germany's Wild Amazon, the Wupper. These forests and rivers, together with heathlands and moors, are home to a diverse fauna. Martens, badgers, wild boars, hares, roe deer, and red deer, even black grouse and hazel deer find shelter in these parts. Wolves also have a dominant presence, not to mention those who live underground, such as lizards, bats, and snakes.

The team uncover the hidden lives of three iconic animals. In the Kalahari Desert they put cameras on wild meerkats, in Cameroon, Gordon and scientist Mimi Swift look at a four-year-old orphan chimp, and in Argentina, penguins carry tiny cameras far out to sea on an epic journey of up to 300 kilometres.

In Namibia, Gordon joins a cheetah conservationist who wants to see if three orphaned cheetahs, which she has raised from a day old, can learn to hunt effectively in the thick vegetation. In Australia, the team put cameras on fur seals to try to see how they hunt their prey and avoid attacks by great white sharks. The team also deploys the first ever cameras on wild baboons in South Africa in an effort to understand why these clever monkeys sometimes raid farmers' crops.

Nearly twice the size of the United States, Russia is the biggest country on Earth. From the subtropics to the arctic and the Atlantic Ocean to the Pacific; giant lakes, active volcanoes and endless forests.

Mountain streams slowly move along meadows before turning into the spray of waterfalls or small mystic lakes. A look at what kind of life can be found in and around this mysterious environment and investigating the world of the rare Danube salmon.
Europe's most fascinating landscapes from an entirely new perspective.

It's no news that cuckoos are brood parasites: they lay their eggs into the nests of other bird species - a clever trick that spares the rearing of own offspring. Some even go as far as to kill the other chicks in the nest. But why do other parent birds let this happen? Are they too stupid? Too inept? Or simply clueless? Admittedly, cuckoo's eggs do look deceptively genuine. But the cuckoo chick? Not even remotely!

In southern Alaska, bald eagles flock by the thousands in autumn for the last salmon migration of the year and to prepare their young for the harsh winter. In the Dolomites, a look at a couple of golden eagles and their offspring.

Armed with 18 venomous spines, the lionfish hunts, invisible to its prey, in packs. Shedding light on the fascinating behaviour that let the lionfish conquer foreign waters, and by doing so threaten entire ecosystems.
Scientific buoys offer a new perspective on the giant oarfish, the planet's largest bony fish and a possible source for legends of sea serpents.
An examination of lions, which are highly social and form prides of up to 35 animals, unlike other cats.
An examination of leopards, which like most big cats, are elusive and need to be virtually invisible to hunt.
An examination of the elusive wild jaguar, which scientists have struggled to get near for many years.

At the end of the summer, a moose finds herself alone in the forest. She has just lost her calf, probably to a bear. Now she must find a mate. Once pregnant again, she will endure months of bone-chilling winter until she delivers in the spring.
Follows two families of river otters in Yellowstone and how they join together to face challenges.
Documents some of the most astonishing and unexpected behaviours of grizzly bears as they live out their difficult lives in the terrain of Yellowstone National Park in the United States.
Gordon Buchanan takes an epic camel ride across the Gobi Desert to discover how these most iconic, yet least understood, animals have adapted to survive in extreme environments.

David Attenborough tells the story of the discovery and reconstruction in Argentina of the world's largest known dinosaur, a brand-new species of titanosaur. Measuring 37m long - close to four London buses put end to end - and weighing 70 metric tons, it now holds the record as the biggest animal ever to walk the earth.
Jenni Falconer takes a sojourn to the beautiful fishing port of Looe in Cornwall to help a couple who want to buy a dream property by the sea.

Alistair Appleton is house-hunting with a couple who have £500,000 to buy their first property together, closer to family in the picturesque Peak District. Whilst in the county, Alistair meets an innovative farmer who is growing a field of furniture.
Drew Pritchard calls on two experts to help with the restoration of a Victorian iron window. Plus, vintage electronic game restorer Mark Squires is asked to rescue a 1950s driving game.
Furniture restorer, Steve is tasked with restoring a huge bench that once happened to grace a famous Scottish court. Meanwhile, Gilder Ruth manages to revive a Georgian mirror frame.
Metalworker, Ted Edley is requested to restore an obscure German football table from the 1950s. Meanwhile, upholsterer, Ray Clarke finds himself reinvigorating a stylish 1980s desk chair.
A huge haul of silver leaves Angus speechless and raises a staggering amount at auction. Later, Angus helps Susan clear a huge collection of railwayana.
Angus struggles to value Victor's homemade curios but gets a surprise at auction. He also searches for treasures in an eclectic collection.

The first visitor to the barn is Sue Kent from Manchester, with an heirloom, and a guilty secret. She is hoping silversmith Brenton West can help restore a prized tea set given to her by her uncle and godfather John.
Drew and Viki head for one-stop-shop locations. They snap up some Ford Maddox Brown chairs and a recliner from a Victorian ocean liner.
Drew and Viki explore new antiques ventures, and discover a Scottish jewellery packing case and a matchstick model made by a prisoner artist.

We follow the stories of two men born in Ireland to unmarried mothers at a time when having children outside of marriage was seen as sinful and the Catholic Church went to great lengths to cover it up.

Steven Moore and Angus Ashworth are out and about in the North East of England. The extremely circuitous open road somehow took hundreds of miles to get there from nearby Melrose in the Scottish Borders. For the viewer who does not know what to do when disaster strikes. Andrew Mitchell from the United Kingdom has some stories to share from his own experience living through the 2016 Kumamoto quakes.
Today's theme: Design Hunting in Yamaguchi. Lying at the western edge of Japan's main island, Yamaguchi is home to arts and crafts which draw on its rich natural landscape. Join us on a design hunt!
Mongolia's culture of meat-eating is contributing to health problems in this developing economy. Chef Suzuki Yuko aims to introduce more vegetables through workshops and improved hospital menus.
In the Edo period, childbirth was a community affair, with the mother-to-be attended by a midwife and the women in her life. It was also characterised by unique customs and superstitions.

A Japanese doctor takes an innovative approach to unexplained neck and shoulder pain. Treating nerves in the wrist or elbow can help. We look to new research for clues to where pain really comes from.

Developer Ikezaki Hidekazu speaks about the development of taste sensing systems. Reporter Ishii Terumi observes a taste sensing system demonstration. Featuring University Professor Toko Kiyoshi, who pioneered the concept behind taste sensors.
Peter Barakan offers insights into Japan through both his own experience with the country and by meeting experts across a variety of fields within Japanese art, culture and science.
A preview of upcoming programmes from BBC Two.
Flo and Sue are in Stevenage to help mother and daughter Margaret and Elizabeth transform their south-facing garden.

Ross Kemp presents this quiz show where a team of four friends, Louise, Mark, Suzy and Rich, take on the Bridge of Lies. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will halve their money.
Simon Reeve treks and canoes through Canada's frozen Yukon Territory, meeting resilient locals who brave the wilderness and searching for majestic grizzly bears.
Nick Robinson in conversation with people who influence our political thinking.

Contestants compete across the series, scoring points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.
Comedian Jason Manford hosts an exciting, fast-paced quiz show where three couples face a series of 50/50 questions which hurtle the Answer Run down towards them.
Susan Calman hosts the quiz show where being in control is everything. Who will emerge as the Boss and walk away with the cash? Only the strongest players will survive the game.
Michael concludes his journey from Cumbria to Dumfriesshire by crossing the Solway Firth into Scotland, where he visits the beautifully preserved last home of Scotland's greatest poet, Robert Burns.

Dublin-based architects Fiona and Paddy plan on converting a derelict cowshed on the Rockingham Estate into a contemporary family home, and commence their restoration project with a budget of €350,000.
At Hampton Court, treasures are a bronze produced by Rodin, an early long case clock, and a sketch by abstract artist Mondrian valued at over £50,000.

Paul Martin presents from Ragley Hall in Warwickshire, a beautiful 17th-century Palladian house owned by the Marquess of Hertford. Antiques experts Charlie Ross and Will Axon find great treasures among hundreds of visitors to the stately home.
Chizzy Akudolu, Stephen Bailey, Banjo Beale and Philippa Dunne test their general knowledge skills on this week's House of Games.

Ellie Taylor is on hand with more behind-the-scenes action and is joined by a trio of Strictly all-stars to discuss all things ballroom. Plus, more exclusive interviews with some of the remaining celebrities.

Dougie is in the Borders to round up all the action from the Sheep Dog World Trial at Lauder. He finds out how the family hosting the event turned their working farm into a championship venue and also meets some of the international competitors and their dogs taking part.

Frances Tophill is tackling jobs in the autumn garden and introducing plants that keep colour and interest going for as long as possible.

We follow the end of Henry's marriage to Katherine of Aragon, made by possible by Henry's rejection of Catholicism and the pope, with him setting himself up as head of the Church of England. He marries his second wife, Anne Boleyn, and she gives birth to a baby girl - Elizabeth.

Multi-Oscar-winning thriller about a trainee female FBI agent who is seconded to the hunt for a horrific serial killer. For insight into the workings of his diseased mind she turns to the psychotic yet urbane Dr Hannibal 'the Cannibal' Lecter, with whom she forms a compelling and dangerous relationship.
A woman thinks she's found the perfect dress in a winter sale, while browsing at a London department store, but she soon discovers it carries a horrific curse.
A London cabbie murders his victims by posing as a police officer.
Two crooners anxious to dodge marriage proposals sign on as deep-sea divers. They discover sunken treasure and fall for the same girl - fabulous Balinese princess Lala.
A mysterious baby is found in a boat at sea, in a charming portrait of a small coastal community in Coverack.
A group of talented young performers buy a dilapidated theatre to showcase their acts, but unscrupulous property developers plan dirty tricks to disrupt the first night's performance.

Vintage British thriller in which a Scotland Yard inspector investigates the murder of amateur footballer John Doyce during a charity soccer match against Arsenal at Highbury. Much of the film was shot at Highbury itself, with appearances from Arsenal manager George Allison and members of the team.

An apparently simple investigation of the murder of an ageing showgirl by her lover in Hampstead Heath is complicated by several factors. A police detective and a lawyer for the defence attempt to unravel the mystery.
Robin starts to make plans after stumbling upon a hoard of gold, but discovers that King John stole the gold from his own mother. He and his men set out on a dangerous mission to return the treasure.
Exclusive interview with Patricia Dainton who discusses her time on this film and her career in general.
The cast and crew of a new musical revue start rehearsals in a supposedly haunted theatre.
Patricia Dainton wishes a fond farewell and looks back on her life in film.

Mrs Osborne's emeralds have been stolen from her hotel room. She doesn't want the insurance, instead she wants Eastern to get the emeralds back. Cat burglar Harry Flash is suspected, so John Hunter tries to track him down.
Out in the desert, Phillip comes to the aid of a Sergeant stuck in an abandoned vehicle surrounded by mines.
New Year's Eve can be very lonely for people in the rooms, so Sarah opts to throw a party.
Debt collectors suggest 'payment in kind' after the wife of a struggling businessman falls behind on hire purchase payments.
A bailiff is attacked after trying to evict residents of a poverty-stricken building. The team must investigate the volatile situation.
Madge Reading turns to Marker when she suspects there is another woman in her husband's life.
Welcome down into the Cellar Club where tonight Caroline Munro has a terrifying treat with the 1971 thriller Fright, starring Honor Blackman and Dennis Waterman.
A babysitter is terrorised by a homicidal maniac who's escaped from a mental institution to kill his ex-wife.
As the end of this week's Cellar Club draws near, Caroline Munro is here to talk about what is coming up next week.

Tongue-in-cheek chiller about a ruthlessly sadistic student who will stop at nothing in pursuit of advancing his shocking scientific experiments. Young Victor Frankenstein murders his own father in order to inherit his title and fortune, and drops out of school to concentrate on his unholy attempts to resurrect dead creatures.
Agnes Keith is a woman who, with her husband and young son, are captured by the invading Japanese in Borneo in 1941 and then segregated in a prison camp.
An LAPD officer discovers a police task force is harbouring a horrific secret that endangers residents of the housing projects he grew up in.

Hilarity and horror ensue when toothy, carnivorous aliens escape from their space prison, pursued by two merciless bounty hunters. When they reach the Kansas farmhouse of an all-American family, the humans do everything they can to fend off the critters, but they cannot free themselves of the ferocious outsiders.
A clairvoyant therapist confronts her own personal demons while trying to save a young girl who believes a malevolent entity is feeding on her.

As the search to find a rare flower in the jungles of Borneo gets underway, the situation deteriorates rapidly. First infighting amongst the research team breaks out, but soon they have a problem which unites them; there is a very large and very hungry snake present.

Attacked by an unseen animal, Blake and his family barricade themselves inside a farmhouse as the creature prowls the perimeter. As the night stretches on, however, he begins to behave strangely, transforming into something unrecognizable.

Ramona becomes crippled by grief after the death of her husband, leaving her to care for her two children alone in her farmhouse. Her sadness soon turns to fear when a spectral woman in black appears on her front lawn, warning her "today's the day."

Parapsychologist Elise Rainier and her team travel to Five Keys, N.M., to investigate a claim of a haunting in her childhood home. She must soon confront and destroy her greatest fear -- the demon that she accidentally set free years earlier.

After a difficult struggle with fertility, Tori Breyer's dreams of motherhood come true with the arrival of a mysterious baby boy. Brandon appears to be everything Tori and her husband, Kyle, ever wanted - bright, talented and curious about the world. But as Brandon nears puberty, powerful darkness manifests within him, and Tori becomes consumed by terrible doubts about her son. Once Brandon begins to act on his twisted urges, those closest to him find themselves in grave danger.
Trying to leave their troubled lives behind, twin brothers return to their Mississippi hometown to start again, only to discover that an even greater evil is waiting to welcome them back.

It's been 40 years since Laurie Strode survived a vicious attack from crazed killer Michael Myers on Halloween night. She now faces a terrifying showdown when the masked madman returns to Haddonfield, Illinois, but this time, Laurie's ready for him.
When a new Ghostface killer emerges in the quiet town where Sidney Prescott has built a new life, her darkest fears are realised as her daughter becomes the next target.
Dr Kelson makes a discovery that could change the world, while Spike's encounter with cult leader Jimmy Crystal becomes a nightmare he can't escape.
Mannering's assistant is kidnapped from the shop and a ransom is demanded for his safe return; Mannering is forced to sell a fake Renoir painting to secure the money.

Skipper, Kowalski, Rico and Private are recruited by a secret organisation to help bring down an evil supervillain, Doctor Octavius Brine. He holds a grudge against the animals that stole the limelight from him.
Stranded in the wilderness, a mule deer and a domesticated bear try to make their way back to the safety of a town preserve before a hunter catches them.
A domesticated terrier and his unruly canine pal encounter a rebellious bunny and his gang of abandoned pets.
The film explores the bonds between pets and the families that love them, and answers the question: What are your pets doing when you’re not at home?

Po might just be the laziest, clumsiest panda in the Valley of Peace, but he secretly dreams of becoming a kung fu legend. When the villainous snow leopard Tai Lung threatens Po's homeland, the hapless panda is chosen to fulfil an ancient prophecy and defend the Valley from attack. Training under Master Shifu, Po embarks on an epic high-kicking adventure as he sets out to thwart Tai Lung's evil plans. A DreamWorks animation.
A panda must unlock the secrets of his past in order to defeat a formidable villain who plans to wipe out kung fu and conquer China.
After reuniting with his long-lost father, Po must train a village of clumsy pandas to help him defeat a supernatural warrior who becomes stronger with each battle.

Award-winning DreamWorks animation from the Aardman team, telling the story of a band of chickens doomed to a life of egg-laying on a Yorkshire chicken farm. When a flamboyant American rooster arrives on the scene, the hens hope he can teach them to fly to freedom. However, when a chicken-pie making machine is installed, their need becomes urgent, and they must devise other means of escape.
Poppy, the optimistic leader of the trolls, and Branch, her polar opposite, embark on an adventure that takes them far beyond the only world they've ever known.

Master Wu, who is as wise-cracking as he is wise, leads a fierce team of secret ninja warriors to defeat the evil warlord Garmadon and save Ninjago City. He will need all of his cunning and guile to defeat his enemy.
Movie, Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Action

The citizens of Bricksburg face a dangerous new threat when LEGO DUPLO invaders from outer space start to wreck everything in their path. The battle to defeat the enemy and restore harmony to the LEGO universe takes Emmet, Lucy, Batman and the rest of their friends to faraway, unexplored worlds that test their courage and creativity.

A life-saving surgery fuses together a police officer and his faithful police dog -- and Dog Man is born. Learning to embrace his new identity, Dog Man must stop feline supervillain Petey the Cat from cloning himself and going on a crime spree.
A young boy searches for a way to gain the affections of his dream-girl. In his quest he learns that in order to succeed he must uncover the story of the grumpy but nature-loving Lorax.
Previews of the great films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky.

In the 1950s, New York crime bosses Frank Costello and Vito Genovese vie for control of the streets. Once the best of friends, petty jealousies and a series of betrayals place them on a deadly collision course that reshapes organised crime forever.

Seafaring drama based on the true story of a commercial fishing boat crew who become caught in a terrifying storm off the coast of Massachusetts. In the autumn of 1991, a fishing boat captain is determined to set sail despite the adverse weather conditions, but when the ice machine breaks down his decision to brave the storm rather than lose his catch results in a battle against 100ft waves.
He balances books by day and bodies by night. A maths savant hiding behind a CPA desk, Christian Wolff crunches numbers for cartels and killers - until one error adds him to the equation.

John and Jane Smith are a typical suburban couple first seen undergoing marriage counselling to try and get the spark back in their relationship. What neither of them knows is that the other is a highly skilled assassin until, separately, they get a call for their next job. Accidentally double-booked, they discover the truth about each other's secret existence, and are in danger not just from their bosses, but each other.
Movie, Action, Romance, Comedy, Crime drama, Thriller

Terror strikes in the heart of Mumbai, India, as members of Lashkar-e-Taiba storm the Taj Mahal Palace Hotel in a series of coordinated attacks throughout the city. Amid the gunfire and mayhem, a brave chef and kitchen worker decide to risk their own lives to try and protect the frightened guests. As the militants continue their assault on the hotel, a desperate couple must do whatever they can to protect their newborn baby.

Thriller adapted from Thomas Harris's first Hannibal Lecter novel about an FBI profiler called out of retirement to help catch a serial killer nicknamed the Tooth Fairy. The agent has the uncanny ability to project himself into the minds of his criminal prey, but the case forces him to confront his past and consult his former nemesis, the now-incarcerated Dr Hannibal Lecter.

While out hunting, Llewelyn Moss finds the grisly aftermath of a drug deal. Though he knows better, he cannot resist the cash left behind and takes it with him. The hunter becomes the hunted when a merciless killer named Chigurh picks up his trail. Also looking for Moss is Sheriff Bell, an ageing lawman who reflects on a changing world and a dark secret of his own, as he tries to find and protect Moss.

Based on three hybridising narrative strands, three groups of villains are intent on retrieving a missing diamond. Turkish and Tommy team up with a pugilistic Irish gypsy named Mickey for the purpose of rigging unlicensed boxing matches. However, their opponent also arranges some dodgy betting with the courier of the stolen diamond, who subsequently goes missing. To complicate further, a New York gangster arrives on the scene.

A new kid at a school is targeted by a school bully and his gang and seeks help from a handyman, who is also a karate master. With gruelling training and much patience, the young man learns martial arts from the handyman.
Old rivalries and new adversaries await Daniel and Mr Miyagi as they travel to Okinawa to visit Miyagi's ailing father.

A boy trained in the martial arts is alienated from his mentor just when he needs to prepare for a showdown with his arch-enemy. Instead, he turns to a Vietnam vet who teaches him how to fight dirty - a strategy the youth comes to realise is a mistake.
Movie, Drama, Martial arts, Action, Dark comedy
After moving to China, a twelve-year-old boy falls in love with one of his classmates. This soon comes to the attention of the class bully.
Movie, Family, Drama, Martial arts, Action

On the isle of Berk, a Viking boy named Hiccup defies tradition by befriending a dragon named Toothless. However, when an ancient threat emerges that endangers both species, Hiccup's friendship with Toothless becomes the key to forging a new future.

When evil wizards Razamel and Gargamel take Papa Smurf, the Smurfs embark on a mission to the real world to save him. With help from some new friends, they must discover what defines their destiny to save the universe.

After the three young Baudelaire siblings are left orphaned by a fire in their mansion, they are carted off to live with their distant relative, Count Olaf. Unfortunately, Olaf is a cruel, scheming man only after the inheritance that the eldest Baudelaire, Violet, is set to receive. The children escape and find shelter with their quirky Uncle Monty and, subsequently, their phobic Aunt Josephine, but Olaf is never far behind.

Alan Parrish disappeared as a young boy. Nobody believes his friend's story that he was sucked into the game they were playing. Twenty-six years later, two children find the game in their attic, and when they start to play, Alan is released, but the game isn't over yet, and Alan must finish before he is really free.
Four teens embark on the adventure of a lifetime when a video game magically transports them to the jungle and transforms them into adults.

When Spencer goes back into the fantastical world of Jumanji, pals Martha, Fridge and Bethany re-enter the game to bring him home. But everything about Jumanji is about to change, as they soon discover more obstacles and more danger to overcome.
The Masai Mara and Kenyan National Parks, LIVE each morning. From big cats to sweeping plains, discover the daily rhythm of Africa's wild heart.
Having different chefs from different Arab countries prepare dishes that are famous throughout the region.

Interior designer, Rose DeMonte, uses her skills back in her hometown to renovate a Christmas Charity Home for her brother Sal and his contractor Brysen's home flipping company.
Eager to avoid Christmas, Ella Neezer, a CEO, books an international trip that skips the holiday, until three spirits journey Ella through her life to rediscover her Christmas spirit.
Melanie wants to create an inclusive Christmas dance for her daughter Jenny, not realising Jenny is planning a dance of her own to honour Melanie.

Young Jim has to grow up fast after the Japanese invade Shanghai. Separated from his parents and alone in a prisoner of war camp, Jim must fight to survive.

Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis, quickly christened 'Joker' by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant, and pudgy Private Lawrence, nicknamed 'Gomer Pyle', as they endure the rigours of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering, and eventually participating in, the Battle of Hue.

Classic Oscar-winning tough comedy adventure set in First World War Africa featuring a hard-drinking, woman-hating owner of the 'African Queen', a decrepit steamer that trades up and down the river, and a strait-laced spinster sister of missionary Rev Samuel Sayer, whom he has agreed to take back to civilisation.

Sweeping epic about three sons raised on a Montana ranch by their father, a colonel who has turned his back on the army after the Indian Wars. Though the destinies of the boys are very different, two forces impact on each of their lives: the Great War in Europe and the love of a young woman. Covering several decades, the action ranges from majestic Montana to the battlefields of Europe and adventure on the high seas.

When petty criminal Luke Jackson is sentenced to two years in a Florida prison farm, he doesn't play by the rules of either the sadistic warden or the yard's resident heavy, Dragline, who ends up admiring the new guy's unbreakable will. Luke's bravado, even in the face of repeated stints in the prison's dreaded solitary confinement cell, 'the box' makes him a rebel hero to his fellow convicts and a thorn in the side of the prison officers.

Andy Dufresne and Ellis Boyd 'Red' Redding are two prisoners serving long sentences in the vicious Shawshank jail. The two come to terms with their imprisonment while surviving the sadistic acts of prison warden Samuel Norton, and for both, a different sort of redemption awaits.
A teenage girl wants revenge on the man who killed her father, but she needs help from legendary one-eyed marshal "Rooster" Cogburn, and a Texas Ranger.

In an England of the future, Alex de Large is the leader of a gang of droogs whose pastime is violence, sex and murder, but whose eventual punishment is almost as extreme and violent as his crimes. Betrayed by the other members of his gang, he is arrested and offered an experimental treatment in order to shorten his sentence.
Dr Ryan Stone and Matt Kowalski are stranded in space with no way to contact Earth after their shuttle is destroyed in the midst of a routine space walk.

The fate of humanity is at stake when two races of robots, the good Autobots and the villainous Decepticons, bring their war to Earth. The robots have the ability to change into different mechanical objects as they seek the key to ultimate power, but only human Sam Witwicky can save the world from total destruction.
Mikaela and Sam once again join forces with Optimus Prime again to save Earth from ruthless robot The Fallen.

The Autobots and the Decepticons become involved in a space race to find a hidden Cybertronian spacecraft stranded on the Moon. Sam Witwicky must come to the aid of the Autobots to defeat the evil Decepticons to stop them discovering the secrets of the Cybertronian craft.
As humanity picks up the pieces after an epic battle, a shadowy group emerges to gain control of history. Meanwhile, a powerful new menace sets its sights on Earth.
As war with the Transformers rages on, inventor Cade Yeager forms an unlikely alliance with Bumblebee, an English lord and an Oxford professor to save the planet.

Two teenage cousins dig deep to find self-acceptance and a date to the Debutante Ball in a small country town in Australia.

A highly contagious and rapidly mutating microorganism starts to multiply as it unleashes its brain-controlling, body-bursting terrors at a former military base.

Ex-fighter Joe helps run his partner Estrella's farm in Mexico. After taking underground fights to support workers, he's forced to defend himself and Marco when Chavez's gang attacks them on the road.

Iain defies orders and runs into a burning building to save a man in search of his new fiancée. Meanwhile, Lily steps into the breach as a magician's assistant when pensioner Yvonne gets injured.

Paul and Terry exchange vows, bringing family and friends together to celebrate the union.
Des discovers that his house has been ransacked, and Maria leaves for Hong Kong.

A local criminal, Billy 'The Brick' Porters is the subject of the village's suspicion when the mayor of Arden is found murdered in his cottage in the dead of night. Lu and Frank try to exonerate the criminal.
The circus brings death to Kembleford when a clown is murdered. Father Brown must determine who the killer is and why a parishioner has agreed to marry the sinister wizard Welkin.
After Lionel accidentally walks in on Sandy in the bathroom, Jean decides to add a second bathroom. The second bathroom plan doesn't happen quite as Jean suspects it will.

A round-up of the day's news.

The Stuarts are confused by the newly-discovered drink of tea, a Viking funeral ends in a massive fight, a child evacuated in the Blitz thinks farm animals are monsters and some cowboys sing about life in the Wild West.

Shrek is just starting to settle down in his beloved swamp with his wife Fiona, but their mucky bliss doesn't last for long as word arrives that the ogre's froggy father-in-law is about to croak. The very last thing Shrek wants is to become King, but with no other heir in sight, it looks like the grumpy green one is destined never to live quietly in the swamp again. A glimmer of hope appears in the form of heir Artie. A DreamWorks animation.
The team is challenged by a perplexing poisoning during a performance of The Tempest. Meanwhile, Mervin must decide what to do about a difficult development involving his brother.

Lotto fever has hit Foley's bar, and it doesn't take long before rumours swirl around Finglas that Agnes is the jackpot winner. Meanwhile, a DNA test and the surprise return visit of Cathy's childhood friend leaves Agnes with questions.

Dermot and Maria decide to renew their wedding vows, forcing Agnes to organise the ceremony alongside arch-nemesis Hillary and cope with her high-society demands. Meanwhile, Fathers Damien and Trevor go on a mountain pilgrimage that goes wrong.
Mrs Brown becomes a podcast sensation - without even leaving the house. Cathy is horrified to discover her mother accidentally hijacks her new podcast project.

To save his own job, Alan gets radio colleague Pat laid off, but when the man returns to the station with a shotgun and a siege ensues, Alan is given the high-profile role of go-between, trying to appease both the hostage taker and armed police.
Lisa, Scooter, and company driver Muskie Todd team up as a three-truck convoy to take on the notorious Asheweig Road. The trio must work together to survive a looming disaster.

Jeremy drives the Citroën C2, Richard compares two new French coupe convertibles, Renault's Mégane and Peugeot's 307, and James gets dewy-eyed over the Aston Martin Vantage V8. Meanwhile, Sanjeev Bhaskar is the Star in a Reasonably Priced Car.

A huge shipment of cocaine is found hidden in the floor of a truck. A young man tries to enter the United States to enrol in school. A woman is caught smuggling fentanyl pills, and a drunken couple refuse to pay their fine for illegal avocados.

A woman is caught trying to enter the US with a baby that isn't hers. A man wanted for a serious crime is intercepted. A driver suffers a heart attack while crossing a bridge, and a shipment of coconut oil is discovered to contain methamphetamine.

Rick Stein approaches the end of his meander through France with a final glance at the culinary delights of the Languedoc before crossing over to Provence and the Mediterranean coastline that continues to reveal new insights into southern French cuisine.
Rick Stein explores the food and cuisine of Shanghai, one of China's largest cities. Rick tastes rich red braised pork, the city's cherished hairy crabs and a particular type of Chinese dumpling.

Jimmy promises to return to Bombay and become a famous entertainer so that he can exact revenge on Mr Oberoi for having insulted and imprisoned his mother on false charges.
The stories of four families facing their own dilemmas and problems which leave them fated to meet each other in a variety of ways, changing their lives forever.

Georgina will eine Vintage-Kommode für ihren Mann als Überraschung restaurieren. Sie ist bereits seit vier Generationen in Familienbesitz und benötigt eine Menge Pflege. Cecile Taylor hat zwei Sessel im 1920er-Jahre-Stil im Gepäck.

Als Randy Wayne die Idee strikt ablehnt, im Pfandhaus Brautkleider zu verkaufen, entwickelt sich ein trügerisches Doppelspiel. Außerdem bezahlt ein Ex-Häftling mehr als erwartet, und ein unzufriedener Kunde fordert lautstark sein Geld zurück.

Ein Raubüberfall auf das Geschäft alarmiert das Sicherheitsteam. Währenddessen übernimmt Elyse die Leitung des Ladens und ein Tandem bringt schließlich Wayne und Randy zusammen. Gemeinsam versuchen alle, die angespannte Lage wieder zu beruhigen.
Dieter führt an sich selbst einen Versuch durch: Er schluckt das Hundepotenzmittel Rüdol. Anfangs sorgt es für ein stichfestes Ergebnis in seiner Hose, doch dann bekommt er starke Magenbeschwerden.

Nachdem es in Köln verstärkt zu Einbrüchen gekommen ist, hält Dieter eine Alarmanlage für die Siedlung als zwingend erforderlich. Herr Makielski ist aber dagegen. Um den Chef von der Notwendigkeit des Vorhabens zu überzeugen, bricht er bei ihm ein.

Sportlegende Guido Schröter, Axels Idol aus Kindertagen, gibt eine Autogrammstunde im Baumarkt. Axel stellt entsetzt fest, dass Guido gar nicht so ein harter Kerl ist, wie er angenommen hat. Guido heftet sich zu allem Überfluss an Axels Fersen.

Das alljährliche Kicker-Turnier steht an und Axel soll für den Baumarkt spielen. Da seine Kollegen keine Ahnung vom Kickern haben, schätzt Axel seine Chancen auf den Sieg eher gering ein. Aber Herr Marsch entpuppt sich als wahrer Profi.

Heike und ihr Sohn steuern ein ferngesteuertes Boot auf dem Wasser - oder steuern sie da stattdessen ihren Mann und Vater? Außerdem trägt Kim Jong Il ab sofort seine Meinungen bei. Das kann ja etwas werden.

Als Prozessoptimiererin der Märchenwald AG setzt Dr. Schlüter-Monheim einige Richtlinien um, die den Spaß der Besucher stark beeinträchtigen könnten. Denn dem Prinzen ist es ab sofort nicht mehr genehmigt, das Dornröschen wachzuküssen.
Annes Ex-Freund Jo ist ganz plötzlich zu Besuch gekommen und hängt sich an die beiden dran. Er will neue Energy-Drinks an Fitnessstudios verkaufen, doch Bastian verhindert dies unabsichtlich.
Bastian rettet Regine im letzten Moment das Leben, als er sie von der Straße zieht. Seit diesem Vorfall scheint sie Bastian zu vergöttern und behandelt ihn wie einen lebendigen Schutzengel.

Kinder sagen meistens, was sie denken und stolpern dabei in die lustigsten Situationen. Die erfolgreichsten und charmantesten Homevideos mit Kindern werden in der heutigen Ausgabe der beliebten Reihe Bitte lächeln! präsentiert.

Sit back and be entertained with all your favourite shows, Animal Fanpedia, SpongeBob SquarePants, Pat The Dog, Adventure Time, Clarence, Sadie Sparks, Mo Shaol Do Shaol, Na hInnealtóirí and so much more.

Always test our new gadget first! But, remember, nothing (not even cool gadgets) replace teamwork.

Máirtín Tom Sheáinín chats to Éamonn Ó hArgáin on the show. A Kerryman by birth, Éamonn now lives in Dublin with his wife Mairéad. Éamonn has worked with Bord na Gaeilge and with Fóras na Gaeilge and is now President of Comhaltas Ceoltóirí Éireann.

When a heavy summer storm strikes Central Europe with gales, lightning, hail and torrential rain, we witness how the native animals come through it.
Dáithí Ó Sé presents a talk show that invites weekly guests to chat about a range of topics.

This episode looks at travel and transportation in Ireland in the aftermath of the Second World War. Harry Ferguson earned worldwide recognition as an inventor who revolutionised farming through his tractors.
Fiddle player Doireann Ní Ghlacáin travels to Tyrone to explore a region where music remains deeply rooted. She meets some of the county's finest musicians who represent the distinctive Tyrone style.
Four soldiers of fortune are hired by a wealthy rancher to rescue his beautiful young wife who has been kidnapped by a villainous Mexican bandit. Is she really being held against her will?
The Pet Collective is home to the top trending clips, most entertaining memes, and funniest animal videos online.
Axl and Hutch buy an RV to live in but soon discover problems, Frankie tries teaching Sue how to flirt, and Brick begs Mike to teach him to become a man.

Frankie takes care of Sue and Axl after they have their wisdom teeth removed. Brick tries to impose new house rules. Mike is angry when Rusty suggests Marlene may be entitled to all profits from the diaper business.
After doing well in the diaper business, Mike surprises the Heck family with a holiday at Mammoth Cave, Kentucky. Frankie suggests the Donahues join them on the trip.
After choking on a breakfast sausage, Sheldon refuses to eat solid foods, and he discovers comic books for the first time.
Sheldon struggles with newfound popularity after utilising statistics to help the football team.
Sheldon is determined to be proved right when a NASA official comes to school and dismisses one of his scientific suggestions.

Things don't run smoothly as Amy and Sheldon's cohabitation experiment continues, forcing Leonard and Penny to intervene when the couple has an argument about the 'bathroom schedule'. Howard and Bernadette cancel their holiday plans when Bernadette feels unwell. They decide to have a secret stay-cation at home instead, but are disturbed by unexpected guests dropping by.

Penny and Leonard attend a comic book convention, where Penny is surprised to learn that she has fans who enjoyed her performance in the movie Serial Ape-ist. Sheldon and Amy host a brunch at Penny's flat and, prompted by stress about the baby's arrival, Howard makes an impulsive purchase.
After the repairs are completed in Amy's flat, she lies to Sheldon by telling him that the work is still ongoing so they can carry on living together for a while longer.
Sheldon goes to great lengths to convince Amy that they should have a baby together after they successfully complete a scientific experiment using DNA samples from both of them.
Sheldon can't contain his jealousy when he hears that his university colleague Bert the geologist has won a prestigious fellowship with an impressive grant.
Sheldon and Leonard disagree about how to divide their shared belongings. Koothrappali and Stuart fight to be the most helpful to Bernadette during her final weeks of pregnancy.
While Howard and Bernadette welcome their new baby into the world, Amy celebrates her own birthday with Sheldon.
Sheldon and Amy visit Penny and Leonard after the holidays and tell them about their terrible trip to Texas.
When Frankie, Mike, and Brick go out to dinner with Cindy and her parents, they ask the Hecks for a substantial loan. Sue develops a relentless crush on her college professor.
Frankie's lunch with Sue becomes awkward when Sue and her new boyfriend start obsessing over everything that is wrong with the world. Axl tells Mike he wants to quit football.
New neighbours with noisy kids make it impossible for Frankie to relax on her new backyard lanai. Hutch and Axl open a grilled cheese food truck.
The kids try to suggest ways to resolve a family feud when Meemaw refuses to give George Sr. her secret brisket recipe.
George Sr. takes the boys on a road trip to see a space shuttle launch while Mary, Missy, and Meemaw have a girls' weekend at the salon.
George Sr asks Sheldon to help Georgie revise for a maths test when poor grades threaten his place on the football team.
Penny thinks Leonard is taking her for granted and decides to go on a spa weekend with Amy. Wolowitz and Koothrappali try to fix a squeaky floorboard in the baby's room.
Sheldon tests an MIT invention after hearing it can help him read people's emotions, Leonard finds out Penny's brother is coming to town, and Raj asks his ex-girlfriends to give him dating advice.
Leonard and Wolowitz try to distract Sheldon when he slows the progress of their guidance system. Raj and Stuart look after baby Halley while Penny and Amy take Bernadette for a night out.
Sheldon and Amy have their first fight since moving in together. Meanwhile, Koothrappali is shocked at the realities of financial independence when he stops receiving support from his father.
Cut off from his father's fortune, Koothrappali appoints Sheldon to help him get out of debt. Meanwhile, Penny considers joining Leonard at Comic-Con.
Leonard and Penny offer Sheldon's old room to Raj when he's forced to move out of his flat, leading to unexpected conflict.
Leonard, Penny and Raj settle into their new living arrangement and Sheldon expresses an interest in Amy's professional life.

Sheldon pushes himself to the limit when he collaborates on projects with Leonard and Wolowitz as well as Amy on the same day. Meanwhile, Bernadette nears the end of her maternity leave and must return to work.

The couples of 90 Day Fiancé reunite in New York City to talk out the season's biggest issues. Rasit's prank on Thomas escalates into an explosive confrontation. Tension between Catie and Josh reaches a breaking point as she's left in tears.
Dr. Lee is expanding her practice with some exciting new additions. And she's sharing self-filmed footage of her life outside of work.

Koala-Männchen Hunter gibt in der Paarungszeit Vollgas, um bei einer potenziellen Partnerin zu punkten, doch seine Artgenossinnen zeigen sich alles andere als beeindruckt. Hunter muss beweisen, dass er es langsam angehen kann.

Robert Irvine wagt sich ins "The Emporium" in der Stadt Hawk Springs, wo Besitzer Dennis Schwierigkeiten hat, seine Mitarbeiter zu führen. Wenn Robert ihn nicht dazu bringen kann, sein Verhalten zu ändern, verlässt Dennis' Tochter das Geschäft.
Robert versucht einem Paar zu helfen, seine Beziehung und sein 14 Jahre altes Restaurant zu retten.

Chefkoch Robert Irvine reist nach Joshua, Texas, um ein Tex-Mex-Restaurant zu retten. Die Besitzer Carmen und Wayne servieren minderwertiges Essen, die Umgebung im Restaurant ist giftig und auch die Beziehung des Paares ist in einer schwierigen Lage.

Das eritreische Restaurant "Dahlak" kämpft mit Hygienemängeln und internem Zwist. Während Sohn Ephream auf Fast Food setzt, fordert Gordon Ramsay eine Rückbesinnung auf Familienrezepte. Um das Lokal zu retten, muss die Familie endlich kooperieren.

Dieses Mal bekommen die Pfandleiher ein wirklich einzigartiges Angebot: Ein Kunde will seinen 81er Bradley GT II, ein Elektrofahrzeug, für 50.000 Dollar abgeben - eine echte Rarität. Obwohl Seth vor Begeisterung sprüht, kommt der Deal nicht zustande.

Ashley ist sauer. Bisher galt sie im Pfandleihhaus "American Jewelry and Loan" als die mit Abstand beste Verkäuferin von Ringen, Ketten und anderen Schmuckstücken. Doch mit der neuen Mitarbeiterin Karen hat sie starke Konkurrenz bekommen. Karen ist zwar nicht so erfahren wie Ashley, scheint aber ein Naturtalent zu sein und liefert beeindruckende Verkaufszahlen.

Les Gold bekommt eine handsignierte Gitarre von Ace Frehley, einem Bandmitglied von Kiss, angeboten. Die Echtheit der Unterschrift lässt sich durch ein Zertifikat bestätigen. Doch was der Anbieter dafür verlangt, geht Les eindeutig zu weit.

Seth Gold hat herausgefunden, dass die "Star Wars"-Lichtschwerter aus den 70ern und 80ern besonders viel Geld einbringen. Deshalb bietet er dem Verkäufer maximal 100 Dollar für sein Schwert. Außerdem versucht ein Mann, Les zu erpressen.

Den Pfandleihern wird ein AM General Militärlastwagen zum Verkauf angeboten. Tatsächlich zahlen Liebhaber für solche Fahrzeuge enorm hohe Preise. Doch dieses Modell aus dem Jahr 1971 befindet sich in einem sehr schlechten Zustand.

Ein höfliches Auftreten ist Voraussetzung, um im Pfandleihhaus arbeiten zu dürfen. Doch alles müssen sich die Angestellten nun auch nicht bieten lassen. Das Security-Personal muss für Ruhe sorgen. Schließlich rückt sogar die Polizei an.

In dieser Folge sind die Gerichtsvollzieher im englischen Lancashire unterwegs, um dort umgerechnet 5.200 Euro einzutreiben. Bei der Suche nach dem Schuldner treten allerdings einige Schwierigkeiten auf. Schließlich kommt es aber zu einem Treffen.

Die Gerichtsvollzieher sollen in dieser Folge umgerechnet etwa 6.000 Euro eintreiben, doch der Schuldner macht ihnen vorerst das Leben schwer. Zuerst versucht seine Frau, für ihn zu lügen, aber damit kommen die beiden nicht durch.

Die Gerichtsvollzieher sind in dieser Folge in Birmingham unterwegs, um einen Schuldner zu treffen. Dieser hatte den beiden bei früheren Besuchen Gewalt angedroht, weshalb Matt und Garry dieses Mal zusammen mit der Polizei anrücken.

Bracken Fern Manor war ein Haus der Sünden. Inzwischen ist die Villa bei Ghosthuntern jedoch sehr beliebt. Das soll sich ändern, als einer von ihnen angegriffen wird. Derweil wird ein Mann von einem bösen Geist besessen und eine Frau sichtet ein UFO.

Den Besuchern einer Kirche erscheint eine Geisterbraut. Während zwei Männer mit ihrer Drohne Aufnahmen von dem schwer fassbaren Ohio Grassman machen können, werden verängstigte Fährpassagiere Zeugen einer Alien-Invasion bei Sonnenuntergang.

Immer wieder tauchen auch in unserer heutigen Zeit merkwürdige Geschichten auf, die auf eine Art "Spuk" hindeuten. Berichtet wird von Schreien, wie verloren umherlaufenden Personen oder rätselhaften Begegnungen an geisterhaften Orten.

Am Sterbebett der Großmutter erfährt Elke Warbelow ein Familiengeheimnis: Die Frauen der Familie haben seit jeher die besondere Fähigkeit, durch ihre Träume hellseherisch in die Zukunft zu blicken. Tatsächlich beobachtet sie solch eine Gabe an sich.

TAPS untersucht die paranormalen Ereignisse, die die Osterhout Free Library in Pennsylvania heimsuchen. Das Team taucht tief in diese ehemalige Kirche ein, die auf einem von der Gewalt des Unabhängigkeitskrieges blutüberströmten Land steht.

TAPS untersucht ein Herrenhaus in Alabama, das einst Schauplatz von Treffen der High Society, aber auch von Elend und Unglück war. Satori Hawes und Cody DesBiens helfen dabei, Geheimnisse aus dem Jenseits zu lüften und Seelen Frieden zu bringen.

Detective Taylor wird zu einem Lagerhaus gerufen, wo Kym Tanaka erschossen aufgefunden wurde. Danny, der die Umgebung des Warenlagers inspiziert, findet überall geplatzte Farbpatronen. Obwohl der Oberkörper Tanakas zwei Schusswunden aufweist, finden die Ermittler am Tatort nur ein echtes Projektil.

Nicole Garner und ihre Freundin Heather Rollins haben einen Autounfall, bei dem Heather stirbt. Die schwerverletzte Nicole überlebt nur knapp, ist aber querschnittsgelähmt. Als sie nach fünf Tagen aus dem Koma erwacht, wird sie mit einer Plastiktüte erstickt. Die Beamten ermitteln zunächst im familiären Umfeld des Mädchens und im Krankenhaus.

Die Hochzeit von Jill und Adam Chase endet in einem Albtraum: Als das Paar nach der Feier mit dem Auto aufbrechen will, findet es an der Stoßstange seines Wagens die Leiche von Adams Mutter. Diane Chase war Anwältin und vertrat Mafia-Mandanten. Bei seinen Ermittlungen erlebt das CSI-Team einen herben Rückschlag: Nicks Auto ist mitsamt aller Beweise, die sich darin befanden, ist plötzlich verschwunden.

Jeff Powell wird ermordet aufgefunden. Vor seinem Tod scheint er in Las Vegas die Nacht seines Lebens verbracht zu haben: Sein Boss, ein Filmproduzent, hatte Jeff einen Urlaub spendiert, weil dieser für ihn paar illegale Jobs erledigt hatte. Als Gegenleistung hatte er ihm mithilfe einer Event-Firma zu einem ganz besonderen Abenteuer verholfen. Das Team befragt die attraktive Heidi, die Jeff durch die aufregende Nacht begleitete.
Crime drama, Action, Thriller, Mystery, Crime, Docudrama
Die Nachrichten beleuchten die Themen des Tages aus Deutschland und der Welt.

Penny Garden ist durch das Fenster ihres Wohnzimmers gefallen und hat sich tödlich verletzt. Die Ermittler suchen nun mit Hochdruck nach den Schmerzmitteln, die für die Lösung des Falles von großer Bedeutung sein können. Die Tabletten sind in der Drogenszene sehr beliebt.

Amanda Sinclair und Jill Case sterben nahezu zeitgleich: Amanda wurde erschossen, Jill findet man erhängt in ihrer Wohnung. Es stellt sich heraus, dass die beiden Frauen Zwillingsschwestern waren, sich aber nicht kannten, weil sie nach der Geburt getrennt und zur Adoption freigegeben wurden. Außerdem erfährt das CSI-Team, dass Amanda vor kurzem ihre leibliche Mutter gefunden und um ein Treffen gebeten hatte.

Ein Fischer findet im Lake Mead den Cadillac des vor dreißig Jahren verschwundenen Mickey Dunn, der einst als "König von Las Vegas" bekannt war. Im Wagen befindet sich eine Leiche, und bald tauchen weitere Mordopfer auf, die eines gemeinsam haben: Bei allen wurde ein Foto platziert, das Mickey Dunn im Kreise seiner Angestellten zeigt. Doc Robbins kann den Toten aus Dunns Wagen identifizieren: Es handelt sich um den Polizisten Eddie Sanchez.

Wegen eines Feueralarms muss der Beginn einer Geburtstagsparty in einer Agentur verschoben werden. Als die Party mit Verspätung doch noch beginnt, entdeckt ein Mitarbeiter im Liftschacht eine Tote. Sie wurde mit einer Axt erschlagen. Die CSI-Ermittler sind schnell zur Stelle. Aber einen Mörder finden sie vorerst nicht.

Kyle Hamon, der Sohn von CSI-Chef-Ermittler Horatio Caine, hat ein großes Problem: Einer seiner besten Freunde aus der Army ist spurlos verschwunden und wird als Täter in einem Mordfall verdächtigt. Kyle bittet seinen Vater Horatio um Hilfe. Ob Horatio Caine dem Freund seines Sohnes helfen kann?

Das CSI-Team ermittelt in einem Fall von Brandstiftung, bei dem ein Bub ums Leben gekommen ist. Calleigh konnte den Burschen zwar noch lebend aus dem Haus bergen, doch bereits kurze Zeit später starb er an den Folgen des Feuers. Auch Calleigh hat es schlimm erwischt: Die Ermittlerin schwebt aufgrund einer Rauchgasvergiftung in akuter Lebensgefahr. Erst als sie schließlich wieder zu Bewusstsein kommt, kann sie Horatio wichtige Hinweise zur Lösung des Falls liefern.

Pro Woche treten fünf Frauen an fünf aufeinanderfolgenden Tagen gegeneinander an, um zur Frau mit dem besten Stil gekürt zu werden. Dabei gilt es, ein Outfit für ein bestimmtes Event zu gestalten. Am Ende der Woche wird die Shopping Queen gewählt.

Pro Folge vergibt Guido Maria Kretschmer ein Motto und dann müssen zwei Hobby-Deko-Spezialistinnen im direkten Wettbewerb und unter Zeitdruck zeigen, wer das beste Deko-Händchen hat. In dieser Folge ist die Kandidatin Talia dabei.

Brautprofis unterstützen zukünftige Bräute dabei, das perfekte Brautkleid zu finden. Sie beantworten Typfragen und suchen im Hochzeitsmoden-Discounter, in exklusiven Nobel-Boutiquen und Nischen-Brautläden nach dem passenden Traummodell.

Der TV-Koch Roland Trettl heißt Singles aus ganz Deutschland in seinem Restaurant willkommen. Die Kandidaten werden je nach Vorlieben und Abneigungen zusammengeführt und lernen sich zum ersten Mal bei einem Dinner im Restaurant kennen.

Über einen Zeitraum von fünf Tagen bekochen sich fünf Kandidaten bei sich zu Hause gegenseitig. Am Ende eines jeden Abends wird der Gastgeber von den restlichen Kandidaten mit Punkten bewertet und so der Gewinner des perfekten Dinners ermittelt.

Familie Hellberg wagt einen Neuanfang in New York. Doch reicht Fabians Gehalt als Tätowierer für das teure Leben in der Metropole? In Florida wollen Corinna und Andre Eichhorn mit zwei deutschen Geschäftspartnern einen Friseursalon eröffnen.

Fürst Heinz plant, mit goldenen Currywürsten reich zu werden, während die Familie Repede in Deutschland alles aufgibt, um mit Sirupbier neu zu starten. Andrea Goebel hofft, durch einen Luxus-Campingplatz ihre Fernbeziehung zu beenden.

In realen Untersuchungen greifen Experten auf forensische Wissenschaft zurück, um mysteriöse Verbrechen und andere Rätsel zu lösen.

Robin Bach ist Inkasso-Unternehmerin. Sie ist schockiert, als sie erfährt, dass ein Unbekannter in ihrem Namen erfundene Geldforderungen an angebliche Schuldner verschickt hat. Schnell schaltet sich auch die Staatsanwaltschaft ein.

Ute muss mit dem Tod ihres Mannes einen schweren Schicksalsschlag verkraften. Die Polizei ermittelt in diesem Fall und findet heraus, dass mehrere Familienmitglieder ein Motiv und kein Alibi haben. Auch Ute gerät plötzlich unter Verdacht.

Familie Wolter hat für ihren Urlaub mit einem Paar die Wohnungen getauscht. Bestürzt müssen die Wolters feststellen, dass es sich dabei um Mietnomaden gehandelt hat. Vater Jürgen ist jedes Mittel recht, die illegalen Bewohner zu vertreiben.

Holger Behrens fällt aus allen Wolken, als seine Frau Marianne sich von ihm und den Kindern trennt. Nur Hund "Nelso" nimmt sie mit. Die unglaubliche Begründung für die Trennung: Holger kümmere sich nicht mehr genug um ihren vierbeinigen Liebling. Holger vermutet noch andere Gründe für den Auszug, ist aber zunächst mit dem Spagat zwischen Familie und Beruf restlos überfordert und verliert sogar seinen Job.

Mirella und ihr Mann haben die standesamtliche Trauung bereits hinter sich, doch als die kirchliche ansteht, überlegt er es sich noch einmal anders. Er lässt sie vor dem Traualtar stehen und fliegt mit seiner neuen Freundin in die Flitterwochen.

Frau Herzig hat bislang nicht an Geister geglaubt, aber als sie in ihre eigene Eigentumswohnung einzieht, geht der Hokuspokus los. Spukt es in ihrer Wohnung oder spielt ihr jemand einen bösen Streich?

Während des "Las Vegas Open"-Golfturniers wird die Leiche der Golflegende Russell Huntley entdeckt. Auffällig war der Siegeszug von dessen Sohn Danny Nagano am Tag zuvor. Dieser spielte den Favoriten Duffy Mediate überraschend aus und nahm seinem Vater den jahrzehntealten Platzrekord ab. Aufgrund einer heftigen Auseinandersetzung zwischen Vater und Sohn gilt Danny nun als Hauptverdächtiger.

Der charismatische Highschool-Student und geniale Autobastler Trevor Beck fällt nach einer harmlosen Rempelei auf dem Schulflur leblos zu Boden. Erste Ermittlungen ergeben, dass er an nächtlichen Straßenrennen teilgenommen hat und zudem seine Freundin Cindy vermisst wird. Deren beste Freundin Renata und Ex-Freund Miyamoto geraten daher unter Verdacht. Wenig später wird Cindys Leiche gefunden. Das CSI-Team lässt nichts unversucht, dem wahren Täter auf die Spur zu kommen.

Brian Partney wird während eines Familienurlaubs im Fahrstuhl des Hotels erschossen. Obwohl im Aufzug eine Überwachungskamera installiert ist, kann der Täter auf den Aufzeichnungen nicht identifiziert werden. Bei dem Toten findet sich eine Zimmerschlüsselkarte, die zum Zimmer von Mitch Pena im achten Stock gehört, mit dessen Freundin Partney ein Verhältnis hatte und dem das offensichtlich ganz und gar nicht gepasst hat.

Bei der Abschiedsparty der Lamberts, die zusammen mit ihren Kindern auf eine große Reise gehen wollen, wird ihr Kindermädchen Vanessa erstochen aufgefunden. In der Wunde des Opfers findet sich die abgebrochene Spitze eines Keramikmessers. Horatio verdächtigt Jonah, den Sohn der Lamberts, der Tat, weil man bei ihm ein entsprechendes Messer findet. Und Jonah war wütend auf Vanessa, weil sie ihm ein homosexuelles Verhältnis nachgesagt hatte.

Nates Jugendfreund, der Staatsanwalt Ed Kelley, benötigt die Hilfe des Leverage-Teams. Sein Gegner bei den anstehenden Wahlen hat den PR-Berater Reed Rockwell engagiert. Sie wollen Rockwell zum neuen Helden der Nation machen, um ihn dann mit seinen eigenen Waffen zu schlagen.

Ein Treffen mit seinem ehemaligen Arbeitskollegen Owen bringt Nate und sein Team auf die Spur eines im Zweiten Weltkrieg gestohlenen Bildes des Malers Van Gogh. Owen und seine Handlanger bedrohen den Veteranen Charlie, der das Bild damals gefunden und in seine Heimat gebracht hat. Das setzt dem 88-Jährigen jedoch so sehr zu, dass dieser im Krankenhaus landet. Dort nimmt sich "Krankenschwester" Parker des liebenswürdigen Mannes an.
Nach einem schweren Schicksalsschlag will Detective Elliot Stabler sich ein neues Leben aufbauen. Er kehrt zum NYPD zurück, um es mit den mächtigsten Verbrechersyndikaten der Stadt aufzunehmen.
Bell und Stabler erhalten zwei neue Kollegen und untersuchen zwei scheinbar separate Verbrechen.
